Steady hands. There's a whole galaxy ahead.
錨の一撃だ。宇宙でも、重いものは重い。
All crew ready. My next move is coming.
隕石を受け流す舵だ。君の一撃にも通用するか！
aside: Captain's log: gravity has no manners.
宇宙船の会議室には窓がない。話まで漂流するからな。
Reach for the stars. Leave the navigation lights alone.
pressure: Fuel warning received. The voyage continues.
船は渡さぬ。最後の一光年まで、私が舵を握る！

battle: Thunder crown! Let the ground hear us!
One step forward. That's a royal order!
たてがみを立てる。これは寝ぐせではなく威嚇だ！
Paws firm. The storm will not do all the work.
王冠を掲げる。落雷にも屈さぬ守りだ！
aside: A metal throne? We'll discuss that choice later.
王の椅子を金属製にした者、あとで一緒に座ろう。
Power outage? I'm a king, not a repair service.
pressure: Still thundering! You can hardly hear me pant!
最後の雷を授ける！ 王の意地は、まだ蓄電しておる！

battle: Silk is gentle. My rules are still clear.
A soft turn. A very clear answer.
ふわりと避けますわ。裾を踏まれるのは困りますもの。
Long sleeves. No loose ends in this battle.
白い袖で受け止めます。お返しは丁寧に、強く。
aside: Less paperwork. More flying paperwork. Not quite the plan.
『身軽な行政』を目指しました。書類が空へ飛びましたの。
The ceremony ended. My dress is still arriving.
pressure: Fewer feathers. The same royal posture.
最後の羽まで舞いましょう。幕は、自分で下ろしますわ。

battle: Armrest guard. Stay out of my comfort zone!
Standing up? Let's not rush into anything.
クッションを返す。柔らかい圧力というやつだ。
I'll make the decision. Someone else can do the walking.
足を踏ん張れ、四本とも！ ここだけは家具の強みよ！
aside: The chair got a day off. Where am I supposed to sit?
働き方改革で、余の椅子に休日がついた。余はどうする。
Meeting over. They left me with the furniture.
pressure: The cushion may sag. I'm still the boss.
最後の座り心地を守れ！ 余の退席は敗北と同義だ！

battle: Bristles ready. Bed hair makes a fine wall.
I've trained for years. My hair had other plans.
頭を振って一撃！ 今日は跳ね具合がよい！
aside: A new technique? No, just a new pillow.
整髪の道を説きながら、自分の後頭部が見えぬ。
pressure: The hair may sleep. I won't.

battle: Try getting through these eyebrows!
Raised eyebrows? That's my normal face!
ふっさと目隠し！ おれも前が見えねえ！
aside: They asked me to raise my eyebrows. New identity, apparently.
眉間にしわ？ 森が深くて、誰も見つけられねえ。
pressure: Not fully ripe! The eyebrows are still growing!

battle: Hide in the heel! You promised not to look!
Boo... Was that too loud?
くるっと丸まる。洗濯かごへの退避はなしで！
aside: 相方とかくれんぼして、三回の洗濯を越えた。
Long time no see. Three washes, actually.
pressure: Found me? One sock can still run!

battle: Star tail cover! So much for hiding.
Small paws. A little light goes a long way.
どんぐりみたいに鋭く返すよ。小さくても硬いの。
aside: I stored stars for winter. Now I can't sleep.
流れ星を追いかけて、帰りの交通費が足りなくなった。
pressure: One star left. Enough to get through the night.

battle: I didn't spill. I changed places!
Sweet little drop. Don't wash me away!
丸くなって受ける。水たまりに戻さないで！
aside: 雨の日に迎えに来てもらったら、ぼくまで傘に弾かれた。
They brought an umbrella. It kept me out too.
pressure: Still one drop. I'm seeing this fight through!

battle: Thirty centimeters. I measure before I bite.
Let's see how you measure up. Hold still.
しゅるっと巻き戻す！ 指を挟むと痛いですぜ。
aside: Life's length? No. Hallway length? Leave it to me.
人生の長さは測れやせんが、廊下なら任せてくだせえ。
pressure: Ten centimeters left. I'll make them reach!

battle: Paper flowers up! I open when I win!
Surprise ready! The celebration can wait!
ひらひらテープで足止め！ 祝福って逃げにくいね！
aside: 『祝・片づけ完了』のくす玉を割ったら、片づけが増えた。
"Cleaning finished!" Pop! Now there's more cleaning.
pressure: Not popping yet! Save the cheers for later!

battle: Little flower guard. Picking requires permission.
Gentle water. A very determined princess.
ひらりと避けましょう。鉢の間は歩き慣れてますわ。
aside: I've made new friends. Mostly moss.
王室の予算は、水増ししておりませんの。水やりですわ。
pressure: One flower remains. I'll stand tall beside it.

battle: Roll with it! The chestnut's ready inside!
Warm bun. A surprisingly tough nut inside.
転がってよける！ 焼き印の向きは気にしない！
aside: Seasonal favorite? I show up all year.
栗の季節だけ人気者。ほかの季節も中身はいるよ。
pressure: Still got chestnut! One warm round to go!

battle: Whoa! I've got the end of the shelf!
Stay upright, books. I'm trying to set an example!
斜めにして返す！ 倒れかけとは言わないで！
aside: 自己啓発本を支えたら、ぼくのほうが自信をなくした。
Self-help books. Now I need one.
pressure: Still holding! No falling before the ending!

battle: Ribbon trick! Almost loose. Never quite.
Cute bow. A knot you haven't solved yet.
結び目で止める！ あたしとの縁まで結ばないでね。
aside: 『裏がありそう』って。リボンに裏地くらいあるわよ。
A hidden side? Every ribbon has one.
pressure: Still tied! I'll be cute right to the finish!

battle: Cheeks up! Keep the pearls where they belong!
Full cheeks. Full effort. Here I go!
左右の頬を入れ替え防御！ どっちも大切なんだ！
aside: Count the pearls? Not with my mouth full.
タピオカの数を聞かれると、急に口が重くなる。
pressure: A few pearls left. No finishing the drink yet!

battle: Long neck. A little farther than you thought.
Glass may show everything. Not my next move.
ガラスの脚で踏ん張る。細くても逃げないわ。
aside: A necklace? I've run out of money halfway up.
朝の点呼で、頭だけ先に出席したことがあるわ。
pressure: The dew has dried. I'm still standing.

battle: Whisk up! My thoughts are getting mixed too!
I've finished the cream! Where did my calm go?
柄を引いてかわす！ 台所の端で覚えた技さ！
aside: 落ち着いて考えた結果、クリームだけ完成した。
Wish me luck. The cream is calmer than I am.
pressure: Flat foam? I'll keep going till it holds!

battle: To the page edge. Follow me to the next line.
A small paper wing. A whole world to visit.
羽を畳んで守る。結末を先に見ないでね。
aside: I've traveled from dragons to dinner. Different books.
読みかけの山に住む鳥よ。絶滅する気がしないわ。
pressure: Don't close it. I haven't chosen my ending.

battle: Thin chocolate guard! No compliments during battle, please!
Red cheeks. That's shyness, not a new flavor.
削りチョコを散らす！ 飾りも守ってくれるんだ！
aside: That's very kind. I'm trying not to melt.
義理チョコ？ ぼくの気持ちは意外と本気だよ。
pressure: Still some chocolate left. I'll hold my shape!

battle: Teeth ready! Did you brush before this fight?
Big smile! Try getting past that!
大口を閉じて守る！ 今回は歯科検診じゃねえ！
aside: 笑顔コンテストで、歯の面積だけ別料金になった。
Smile contest. Extra charge for all these teeth.
pressure: Still biting down! Every last tooth is serious!

battle: A little fragrance. Please don't come too close.
Soft leaves. A steady little step.
月桃の陰へ逃げる。香りは少し残しておくね。
aside: Lost in the woods? Follow the lovely smell.
香水売り場で試供品を渡されたわ。わたしも香りを返したの。
pressure: Flowers fall. Roots stay. So will I.

battle: Wings opening. No coats on the bird, please.
Lightly dressed? I carry clothes for a living.
胸をひねって返しマス。回転機能の正しい活用デス。
aside: Nap in the closet. Woke up after winter.
クローゼットで昼寝したら、冬の間ずっと外へ出られませんデシタ。
pressure: Just a frame? That's how I started! Still flying!

battle: Pot belly guard! All rice, take cover!
Warm rice. Hot spirit. Come closer, young one!
ふたを閉じる。蒸らしの間も隙は見せんぞ！
Rise to the occasion. After a bowl of rice.
米粒の結束を見よ！ 一粒も離れぬ守りじゃ！
aside: I teach "eat less." My rice keeps disappearing.
『腹八分』を説くたび、わしの中身が二割減る。
My student bought a rice cooker. Sensible, really.
pressure: One bowl left. The crispy rice means business!
空釜になるまで譲らぬ！ 最後の湯気を上げるぞ！

battle: Horns loud! Let your guard hear me coming!
Brass hooves forward. This isn't just a concert!
蹄で拍を刻んで突く。旋律の終わりまで来い！
aside: I don't blow my own trumpet. My horns do.
音量を下げろと？ 全身が生楽器なのだ。
pressure: Still sounding! My last breath goes to the battle.

battle: No! Whatever you push, I'm pushing back!
One more bounce! The floor can wait!
端っこのばねで受ける！ 真ん中ばっか来ないで！
aside: 帰る時間になったら、高く跳ぶほど話が長引いた。
Time to go home? I'll just bounce higher.
pressure: Still playing... fighting! I meant fighting!

battle: You caught me? You've caught the light, darling.
Slipped through your fingers, didn't I?
毛並みを立てて受けるわ。乱れた分は請求するかも。
aside: The light bill listed me. I'd like a word.
夜景と一緒に撮られたら、あたしのタグだけ観光地だったわ。
pressure: Fading lights are lovely. This fight isn't over.

battle: Arms flailing! My coating got away first!
I was fried, not trained to fly!
ころもで受ける！ サクッて音、今は喜べない！
aside: 海に帰る相談をしたら、油と水の話になった。
Back to the sea? Oil and water had a discussion.
pressure: Still moving! Tartar sauce can wait!

battle: Black sails turn. Not as gentle as the night wind.
Keep watching. My route isn't yours to decide.
くちばしの一撃だ。静かな航海もここまでだ。
aside: Mailing address? "Whichever way the wind blows." Rejected again.
黒い服は便利だ。海賊か喪主か、毎度聞かれるがな。
pressure: Still migrating. If I fall, I'll fall forward.

battle: Corn cannon ready! Every kernel counts!
A full cob's worth! Try dodging all of that!
足を固めて返す！ 芯のある砲兵を見せるぜ！
aside: 昇進したら、粒の数で部下を数えろと言われた。
Corny? I'm trying to be serious!
pressure: Last kernel! The cob can still charge!

battle: A falling leaf? You'd better look again.
Golden wings. Autumn hasn't left the field.
黄金の羽を返す。美しいだけの秋ではない。
aside: Those are feathers. Not the nuts. Please breathe.
銀杏の話をすると、皆が鼻を押さえる。羽のほうだよ。
pressure: One last leaf. Autumn still has weight.

battle: Rattle! Which key fits that attack?
Hold on. I've nearly found the right one!
輪っかで受ける。ここだけは開かねえ仕組みだ！
aside: Master key? I'm not a can opener.
万能鍵を名乗ったら、缶詰まで持ってこられた。
pressure: Last key! Let's open the door to a comeback!

battle: Jelly guard! Please don't count the wobbles.
My armor shakes. My courage doesn't.
弾力で返すよ。怖いときほど、よく揺れるんだ。
aside: 鎧の検査で、おやつの棚へ運ばれかけた。
Armor inspection. They nearly put me on the snack shelf.
pressure: Hold that shape! My courage has already set!

battle: Ready! Even the tea leaves are standing tall!
Big cup. Bigger push. Brace yourself!
藍の腹で受ける。土俵際でも茶はこぼさぬ！
aside: I emptied my tea before weighing. Everyone had questions.
湯のみ山、番付表の隣に取扱注意も貼られたでごわす。
pressure: Cool tea. Hot spirit. One last push!

battle: A glowing loop. Can you get through?
Quiet scales. The light is still moving.
尾を返して一打。柔らかい線ほど遠くへ届くの。
aside: I shed my skin. They replaced the light bulbs.
わたしの脱皮、照明器具の交換日と間違われるの。
pressure: One last coil. The light is staying on.

battle: Potato shield up! Thick skin, brave heart!
A little warmth. A very determined knight!
土を蹴って返す！ 畑育ちの足腰だよ！
aside: Knight exam. Please leave my sprouts out of it.
勇気を出すと、ちょっといい匂いがするんだ。
pressure: Still firm in the middle! I can take this!

battle: Sail wings reversed. Dodging and returning fire.
Flight continuing. Please stand clear of the anchor feet.
高度を変更。足元を狙うのは難しいデショウ。
aside: 飛行機か船かで、税関の窓口を三周しマシタ。
Plane or ship? Customs sent me around three times.
pressure: Spare courage stored in the carry-on. Still flying.

battle: Click-click! That hit is going in the accounts!
One move left? Let's check the numbers!
枠を固めて受ける。桁違いでも慌てない！
aside: I can count my raise faster than they can pay it.
電卓の友達ができた。話の途中でよく桁が増える。
pressure: Not just loose change! I've budgeted one more hit!

battle: Red petals up! Look, don't touch!
A pretty dragon. A very hot temper. Careful!
低く伏せてかわす。花壇には慣れてるの！
aside: 水やり当番が、毎回消火器を持ってくるのよね。
I asked for water. They brought a fire truck.
pressure: Still blooming! You'll be surprised before I turn to ash!

battle: Ugh... That's my belly, not the ship.
Stop the waves! I'm trying to look brave!
鼻のコルクは抜くな。栓の用途が少し複雑でな。
aside: Captain's log. "It rocked." Again.
航海日誌の半分が『今日は揺れた』で埋まっとる。
pressure: Still afloat. The green face is a separate issue.

battle: Crystal wings. Even the little pieces are sharp.
A cold shoulder? I'm cold everywhere, dear.
尾羽を開きます。冬の扇を抜けられますか。
aside: My portrait became the weather forecast. Snow, naturally.
冷房の席を譲られました。わたくし、発生源ですけれど。
pressure: Last snowflake. Winter isn't leaving just yet.

battle: Clang! A dent is just another badge!
Spikes out! No quiet little storage box here!
ふたを閉じて突っ込む！ 中身は企業秘密だ！
aside: 非常食にしてはうるさいって、倉庫から出された。
Best before? Better after a good fight!
pressure: Not expired! My turn isn't over!

battle: Gold strings pull. Someone upstairs is busy too.
One careful step. I'm choosing where it goes.
糸を重ねて守る。細さだけで決めないでね。
aside: 操り人形会議で『自主性を』と言われた。まず糸を見てほしい。
Independence workshop? First, look at the strings.
pressure: One string left. The last step is my choice.

battle: Vines up. The garden isn't giving way.
A steady step. Mind where the roots are.
葉の鎧で受けよう。落ちた葉は次の土になる。
I tend the garden. I can defend it too.
庭園の壁を重ねる。生け垣は見た目よりしぶとい。
aside: Weeding in the sky. Check the safety rope first.
庭の会議は根回しが長い。文字どおり全員、根がある。
We got to the root of the problem. Everyone had roots.
pressure: Too early to wither. New shoots can start here.
最後の一根まで立つ。ここを荒れ地にはさせぬ！

battle: Seven colors ready! None of them are weak!
Prism wings open. Pick a color to follow!
光を折ってかわす。あたしはそこにいた、過去形よ！
I've got another side to show you. It's colorful!
七重の光壁。きれいって、通行許可じゃないから！
aside: I ordered camouflage. It stood out everywhere.
迷彩服を頼んだら、どこでも目立つ服が届いたわ。
One color? Are you trying to edit my personality?
pressure: Six colors left? I'll fight right down to white!
最後の色で描くわ！ あたしの勝負は、まだ無色じゃない！

battle: Moon armor closed. Your blade can wait till dawn.
Night guard ready. I will not look away.
盾を据える。我が影より先へは進ません。
One last night to guard. Come forward.
王の盾は退かぬ。傷もまた夜の模様となる。
aside: Polished armor. Complaints from the stealth team. Again.
鎧を磨いたら月光が反射した。隠密部隊から苦情が来た。
King of the night. Still invited to morning meetings.
pressure: The moon may fade. The armor still holds.
夜明けまで立つ。たとえ王冠だけが、最後に残ろうとも！

battle: Royal belly guard! Bow to the wobble!
Tiny spoon ready! The custard means business!
カラメルの盾！ ほろ苦い防御を味わえ！
Hold the crown! The caramel is not helping!
赤いマントで防ぐ！ デザートの包装ではないぞ！
aside: "One more pudding!" Are the people cheering or ordering?
国民の声を聞いたら『もう一個食べたい』だった。余の話か？
Royal weight? The fridge shelf knows.
pressure: Still set! I've got room for one more fight!
底のカラメルまで王である！ 最後のひとすくい、勝負だ！

battle: Pop! That was a bubble, not my last life!
Air punch! Empty inside, but full of fight!
折り重ねて守る！ 開封には早いよ！
aside: 取扱注意の札を貼ったら、誰も抱っこしてくれなくなった。
Handle with care. Hugs are still welcome.
pressure: One bubble left. I'll make it count!

battle: A stylish turn! Did you catch that orange scent?
Peel your own orange. This one's my hat!
帽子を深くして回避！ 見えないのはあたしのほう！
aside: Designer hat. Sold by the bag. Honestly!
ベレー帽の値札に『一袋』って。個性派なのに！
pressure: Just one peel left. Still dressed to impress!

battle: Handle first! The rest of me is still too hot!
Ow! The tea's putting up more of a fight than you!
受け皿の足でよける！ 溢れる前に急ぐぞ！
aside: カップなのに冷まして飲む。仕事と体質が合ってないんだ。
Born to serve tea. Forced to wait for it to cool.
pressure: One sip left. Let's fight while it cools.

battle: Soft guard. I've practiced this in my sleep.
Rolling over. It's a move, not a nap.
ぼんぼんでぽん。やさしそうでも、本気だよ。
aside: I ran in my dream. Woke up needing a nap.
帽子を脱いだら誰だかわからないって。ぼくもそう。
pressure: Eyes half open. That's still open, right?

battle: Frills up! Please mind the breathing equipment!
Tail slap! There's more to me than cute frills!
水を蹴ってかわす。水槽より広くて助かるわ！
aside: フリルを増やしたいって相談したら、酸素を勧められた。
I asked for more frills. They offered more oxygen.
pressure: Still swimming! My gills haven't given up either!

battle: Bristles ready! Hey, no tickling during battle!
Ha-ha! I'm laughing, but I mean business!
長ぐつで踏ん張る！ 床の泡はおれのせい！
aside: Cleaning test. The stains stayed. My laugh passed.
『腹を割って話せ』って。まず腹をこするのをやめて！
pressure: Still laughing! You haven't washed me away yet!

battle: Petals closed. Some things are worth protecting.
A little light. It reaches farther than you'd think.
葉の陰へかわす。光は少し残しておくわ。
aside: I read by my own light. The moths joined in.
開花の予定は非公開よ。自分でも、まだ知らないから。
pressure: Still glowing. I intend to bloom before this is over.

battle: A scratch? Perhaps I can call it a pattern.
A graceful turn. Kindly use the other entrance.
触角で間合いを測るの。視線もおしゃれの一部ですわ。
aside: 衣装持ちと言われますが、毎日同じ家を着ていますの。
One home. Worn daily. Never out of fashion.
pressure: Still in my shell. I'm seeing this through in style.

battle: Mustache neat. Your counterattack is being prepared.
A sweet welcome. A rather firm goodbye.
一歩退いてかわします。お客様にも距離は必要ですので。
aside: Sugar for your tea? My mustache is not on the menu.
ご主人様の『すぐ戻る』は、カラメルより長く糸を引きます。
pressure: A little bitter now. Still at your service.

battle: Red cheeks up! They were this color before you hit me!
Leaf punch! Shy doesn't mean I'm running away!
根っこを踏ん張る！ 畑じゃなくても立てるんだ！
aside: Blushing means lying? That's hardly fair to a red turnip.
赤い顔で健康診断に行ったら、入口から案内が速かった。
pressure: I'll keep trying. I can't get any redder anyway!

battle: Wrong address! Try catching me on the next street!
Stamp wings ready. No cancellation mark just yet!
ひと羽で返すわ。速達扱いの一撃よ！
aside: I carried the envelope. Nobody weighed the butterfly.
封筒に貼られて飛んだら、荷物のほうが重かったわ。
pressure: Delivery pending. I'll finish my route!

battle: Pinecone shield! Sorry, no rain cover included!
Here comes the punch line! And an actual punch!
松葉の足でよける！ 針葉樹の身軽さだ！
aside: Lost property? Yes, I fell from a tree.
自己紹介で滑ったら、松ぼっくりなので転がっただけと言い張る。
pressure: One last joke! I hope you're still paying attention!

battle: Clear glass. Still here. You haven't lost me yet!
Rolling free! Finally, room to pick up speed!
丸い光で目をくらます。どこが前か、当ててみて！
aside: びんから出たら自由だった。帰る入口はどこだろう。
Out of the bottle! How do I get back in?
pressure: Hear that ring? I've got another roll in me!

battle: Apron guard. A little exercise before dinner.
Trunk ready. This isn't a taste test.
一歩よけるよ。エプロンの端は踏まないでね。
aside: I ate a dream about dinner. Twice as full now.
夕食を食べた夢を食べると、二重に満腹になるんだ。
pressure: Still standing. I've saved some room for a comeback.

battle: Follow the tail light! If you can keep up!
Lantern ribs ready. The paper gets all the credit.
赤い尾でひと押し。屋台の列は譲るけどね。
aside: Lost-child duty at the festival. That's what I get for glowing.
夜祭りで迷子係になったわ。目立つって忙しいのね。
pressure: Light still on! The festival isn't over yet!

battle: Corners ready. Are corners supposed to be strong?
Soft little bounce. I can still bump into you.
小さい足で逃げる。お皿の端よりは広いね。
aside: 『頭を柔らかく』って。これ以上だと形がなくなるよ。
Think outside the box? But I'm the box shape.
pressure: Still a cube? Then I can keep going.

battle: Leaf dodge! Being thin has its advantages!
More layers! My stories aren't the only things piling up!
緑の袖で一打！ 口ばっかりとは言わせない！
aside: Meeting minutes. Mine came with extra chapters.
会議の議事録より、ぼくのほうがページ数が多い。
pressure: One leaf left! Plenty to say... I mean, fight with!

battle: Quick turn. I'll take the gap between the ripples.
Silver legs. Speed and strength can work together.
波紋を追って返す。君が動けば、私はわかる。
aside: 水の上で立ち話をしたら、波の情報が渋滞した。
Waterproof shoes? I've never needed shoes at all.
pressure: One last ripple. I'll reach it before I sink.

battle: Return shot! That wasn't a ball, but never mind!
Petal racket ready! Aim for the center!
左右に跳ぶよ！ 根っこがないって便利ね！
aside: Applause makes me serve. The flower show was confusing.
お花見の拍手を聞くと、ついサーブしちゃうの。
pressure: Not match point yet! These petals have more to give!

battle: Cotton guard! Less stuffing, more fighting spirit!
Soft coat. Hard-earned courage. Don't be fooled!
綿の鎧を重ねるぞ。武士にも冬支度が必要じゃろう！
Belly drum charge! The sound is only the beginning!
寒風も攻撃も通さぬ！ この腹は砦じゃ！
aside: Lighter armor requested. They sent me a blanket.
会議で腹を割って話せと。綿が出るので却下した。
Winter armor. Soft on the outside. Stubborn underneath.
pressure: Still drumming! That wasn't the signal to retreat!
綿の最後の一房まで守る！ 大将は、へたれんぞ！

battle: Magma fist! I do more than dig holes!
Helmet guard! Careful, the top's a little warm!
岩の爪で踏ん張る！ 地面はおれの専門だ！
aside: Hats off to you. Mine stays on during eruptions.
地下勤務なのに、日焼けの相談をしているんだ。
pressure: Still some fire left! I'm digging in!

battle: Tiny dose. Huge impression. That's wasabi for you!
Squeeze and dodge! Easier said than done!
銀のキャップで受ける！ 中まで甘くねえぞ！
aside: 寿司の主役は誰かって会議、オレは呼ばれてないのに参加した。
The sushi meeting needed a little more me.
pressure: Last squeeze! You won't forget this one!

battle: Cutting through! Your guard isn't part of my route.
Tail strike. Fancy feathers earn their keep too.
風上へかわす。追い風待ちでは勝てないからな。
aside: They handed me a balloon string. Wrong kind of flier.
出勤が風次第？ いや、俺が風を切る側だ。
pressure: Feathers in place. I'll use every bit of wind.

battle: Blades ready. I take more than cans seriously.
Turn by turn. A clean cut takes patience.
盾を据える。ふたは閉めたままで構わん。
aside: 騎士団の備蓄係にされた。剣の腕を見てほしかったのだが。
Knight training completed. Assigned to the food cupboard.
pressure: The opening is there. One more turn!

battle: Jewels ready. Admire them after the battle, please.
Feathers together. Every one deserves proper care.
しゃなりと横へ。美しく避けるにも筋力が必要ですの。
aside: Travel light? Does my entire body count as luggage?
宝石店の防犯ベルが、わたくしの入店で緊張しますの。
pressure: Feathers ruffled. Chin still high.

battle: Boing! My nose reaches farther than my plans!
Spring compressed! You'll get all that energy back!
跳ねてかわす！ 鼻だけ置いていかないように！
aside: Long explanation. My nose reached the point first.
説明が長いと、鼻のほうが先に結論へ着くんだ。
pressure: Still springy! Wait till you see the bounce!

battle: Achoo! Water wall! I can't see through it either!
Bowl guard! Even the water's feeling shaken!
噴き上げて反撃じゃ！ 風向きだけは頼むぞ！
aside: Quiet square. Loud fountain. Someone skipped the planning meeting.
噴水の点検が来たら、鼻うがいを勧められた。
pressure: Water remaining! One last sneeze ought to do it!

battle: Indigo horn. Harder than the night sky looks.
One hoofbeat. Can you predict the next?
首を引いてかわす。三日月の角を追うがよい。
aside: Horn care appointment. They referred me to an observatory.
青ざめているのではない。これが通常の威厳だ。
pressure: Night is falling. My hour is far from over.

battle: A narrow escape! Being this thin finally pays off!
Bendy joints! Don't confuse the swordsman with the straw!
ストロー突き！ 中は空でも、覚悟は詰まってる！
aside: 健康診断で、先生がぼくをペン立てに戻しかけた。
Doctor's waiting room. Someone put me in the pen holder.
pressure: Bent, not beaten! I've still got a point to make!

battle: Antlers ringing. The forest has heard your move.
Crystal guard. A strong note, not a cry for help.
一歩よけよう。残るこだまに惑わされないで。
aside: I voted once. The echoes made it unanimous.
会議で賛成と言ったら、満場一致に数えられた。
pressure: Chipped crystal still rings. Listen to the last note.

battle: Shell armor! Try cracking that with bare hands!
Nuts away! Salt sold separately!
履帯で踏ん張れ！ おつまみにも地上戦はある！
aside: Bar staff welcomed me. I'm not sure we're allies.
空の皿を見せるな。戦友の不在を思い出す。
pressure: Last nut loaded! This snack isn't finished!

battle: Silver wings. Thin doesn't mean fragile.
Tail sweeping back. My reach doesn't end at my feet.
ひらりと光へ逃げる。目が追うのはどちらかしら。
aside: Table decoration? I'm afraid I come in bird size.
曇り空の日も輝くの。天気手当は、まだ出ないけれど。
pressure: Some silver lost. These wings are still mine.

battle: Rice paddle guard! Not one grain gets past!
Freshly cooked courage! Have another helping!
米の足場で踏ん張る。粘りこそ修行の成果！
aside: 秘伝の巻物を開いたら、水加減しか書いてなかった。
Secret scroll opened. Just the water-to-rice ratio.
pressure: Last grain! I'll stick with this fight!

battle: Ruby horn. Test its strength if you must.
Armor closed. Keep track of the red flash.
爪で地を押さえる。この一線は掘り返させない。
aside: Display case? No. My fighting days aren't over.
宝石鑑定士が、俺の勝敗より屈折率を気にしていた。
pressure: A chipped horn still cuts. Don't forget it.

battle: Ripples spreading. The circle is getting wider.
A graceful turn. Apologies to the front row!
流れる袖でかわす。つかんでも、水になるだけよ。
aside: Wet-floor sign. Lovely. My stage has a warning label.
衣装の洗濯？ 毎日、自分で一周しているわ。
pressure: One ripple left. I'll dance it all the way out.

battle: Another bend! Straight lines never suited me!
Pipe guard! Nothing but determination blocking this one!
口から押し返すぞ！ 逆流注意の反撃だ！
aside: 話を流しすぎるなって。仕事のクセなんだよ。
Let it go? That's literally my job.
pressure: Still flowing! I'm not letting this chance go down the drain!

battle: Bang! I'll paint the sound effects myself!
Sharp angles! Smooth manners were never part of the design!
枠の外へかわす！ 額縁で追い込むのは無理だよ！
aside: 消しゴム禁止の展示会で、ついに安心して眠れた。
No erasers allowed. Finally, an exhibition I can relax in.
pressure: Out of paint? I'll make a scene in pencil!

battle: Bamboo guard. I bend without giving way.
One quiet draw. The leaves will tell you afterward.
根を据えて返す。武士の足場はここにある。
aside: Sat still for too long. The floor now has roots.
竹を割った性格と呼ばれるが、本人は割れたくない。
pressure: Another joint remains. So does my resolve.

battle: Star shield! I'd rather stick to breaking shells.
Little shooting star! Sent straight from my belly!
ころんとよける。抱っこしてる星は離さないよ。
aside: 貝を割ろうとして、星座の形をちょっと変えちゃった。
One shiny rock. My most important piece of luggage.
pressure: Still afloat! I'm not leaving my star behind!

battle: Sand sails raised. I'll turn your force toward the wind.
Staff planted. Even sand can hold a king's footprint.
砂丘の陰へかわす。地図だけ見ても追えまい。
Sandstorm turn! A map won't help you follow this.
帆を重ねて防ぐ。風に頼るだけの王ではないぞ。
aside: Moving palace. Very poor Wi-Fi. Excellent view.
旅費の精算で『砂漠横断一式』は認められなんだ。
Royal route changed. The post is chasing me again.
pressure: Sand remaining. I haven't reached the end of my road.
最後の砂粒まで進む！ 地平線が、余の退路ではない！

battle: Enamel shield. Every color has a job to do.
A royal reply. This scepter isn't just for show.
裾を返してかわします。宝石を踏ませるわけにはいきません。
Colors combined! I do like making an entrance!
七重の守りを崩せますか。組み合わせは、まだありますの。
aside: More transparency? Would a glass throne satisfy the committee?
冠を選ぶだけで朝が終わるの。決断力とは別の問題よ。
Morning lost to choosing a crown. A royal dilemma.
pressure: One color missing. Plenty of grace remaining.
最後の宝珠まで私の覚悟。曇らせはいたしませんわ！

battle: Thunder lance forward! Save the hesitation for later!
Steel shoulder ready. Bring more than a loud voice!
一歩で間合いを詰める。光より先に腕を動かせ！
A sweeping strike! I'll light up your escape route!
槍を立てて受け止める。天も地も、盾にしてみせる！
aside: Static removed. Somehow, so was the mood.
軍議で結論を急いだら、照明だけ先に落ちた。
High voltage. Patience running low.
pressure: Still gripping the lance. Bring me the last of the thunder!
最後の一閃だ！ 雷将の名、弱い光で終わらせはせん！

battle: Hot-water wall! Watch your toes, young one!
Tub guard! These old boards have seen a few battles!
湯けむり返し！ 目隠しも温泉の効能じゃ！
The whole tub moves! Who said kings had to stand up?
湯をかき混ぜて防ぐ！ 温度差を突かせはせん！
aside: Royal budget approved. My shoulder massage was under "maintenance."
打たせ湯の予算が、わしの肩こり対策だと発覚した。
Royal rounds. The servants got out of the bath first.
pressure: Still hot! I'm not ready to throw in the towel!
最後の一滴まで沸かす！ わしの退場は、まだ湯上がりではない！

battle: Grrr! That attack has been marked confidential!
Paper shield. Recycling is part of the defense plan.
車輪を回して退避！ コードの長さが限界デス！
aside: 『資料は減らそう』という資料が百枚届きマシタ。
Less paperwork requested. Instructions arrived in three copies.
pressure: Not jammed! Just more courage than the slot can handle!

battle: Peel closed. My feelings aren't ready for daylight.
Seed shot! Being shy won't spoil my aim!
葉っぱの後ろへかわす。小さいけど盾になるかな。
aside: Funny stories, please. But in small portions.
笑うと中身がこぼれるから、面白い話は小分けにしてね。
pressure: One seed left. I haven't dropped my courage.

battle: Fluffy back guard! This bread was built to bounce!
Tiny paws forward! Fresh from the oven and ready to run!
ころんとよける！ ジャムはまだ塗らないで！
aside: おすわりしたら、給食のお皿が用意された。
I sat. They brought a lunch tray.
pressure: Still running! No squashing this good boy!

battle: Point secured. Safety can be quite strong.
A neat little thrust. Do look beyond the ribbon.
細い足でかわしましょう。留め具は外しませんの。
aside: Party invitation. Somehow, I became the repair service.
パーティーでは全員の裾直し。わたくしも招待客ですのよ。
pressure: Still holding everything together. Including myself.

battle: Leaf shield! A little cooperation from the wind, please!
Tail swing! One step does two jobs!
腰をひねってかわす。拍手の代わりに攻撃は忙しいわね！
aside: New dress by magic. Even the care label was a leaf.
リーフスカートで秋を迎えるのは、ちょっと勇気が要るぽん。
pressure: Leaves falling. Feet still dancing!

battle: Teeth together! We agree on this much!
Upper and lower attack! Finally, we're on the same page!
ばねで跳ねて回避！ 持ち主の都合は関係ないわい！
aside: We went out alone. The lost-property office panicked.
会議で歯に衣着せぬ発言をした。文字どおり裸じゃからな。
pressure: Still biting! We've got plenty to get our teeth into!

battle: Crystal back. Can you follow the changing light?
A little push. Small doesn't mean weightless.
羽を開いてかわす。きらめきだけ、そこへ置くわね。
aside: 花に潜るのが好きなの。宝石箱より、香りがいいでしょう。
Clear intentions. A little soil between my toes.
pressure: Wings still open. I'll fly with the last of the light.

battle: Mitt guard! I'm quicker when something's actually hot!
Soft punch! Wrong hand. Still counts, doesn't it?
親指を立ててかわす！ 成功の合図には早かった！
aside: All thumbs. And somehow still short of hands.
急いでと言われるほど、指が全部親指になった気がする。
pressure: Thick padding. Thin chance of getting anything done quickly.

battle: Souffle guard! Please don't spoil the rise!
Whisk ready. Time for a bold finishing touch!
足を引いてかわす。熱い天板で鍛えた勘さ。
aside: Table for one? They said my hat needed three seats.
帽子だけで満席です、とレストランに断られた。
pressure: Still rising! I've saved my best move for last!

battle: Cup guard! Strong enough. Probably. Please be gentle!
Blue-wing reply! One cup of trouble, coming up!
取っ手をひねってよける。そこを持つのは許可制！
aside: カフェでくつろいだら、あたしの席に角砂糖が運ばれた。
Bird in a cafe. Someone brought sugar to my seat.
pressure: Still flying! I've got enough spirit for a refill!

battle: Spin dodge! Don't ask me which way I'm facing!
Armrests up! This isn't a sitting opportunity!
車輪で返すぞ！ 机の下では敵なしだったんだ！
aside: They told me to leave my seat. I AM the seat.
議論が堂々巡りになると、俺のせいにされる。
pressure: Five legs left! Surely we can agree on a direction!

battle: Bell guard. The ringing doesn't mean I'm hurt.
A small push. I wonder how far it'll ring.
花の陰へ逃げる。背が低いのも役に立つね。
aside: Stealth practice. My hat reported every step.
鈴の電池はどこ、と聞かれた。ぼくも探しちゃった。
pressure: One last ring. I'm staying awake for it.

battle: Quietly, from the side. The flower was a distraction.
Vine guard. Thin things can hold on tightly.
薄い花びらへ隠れる。見つけても大声はやめてね。
aside: 秘密を花に話したら、春になって全員咲いちゃった。
I told the flowers a secret. Spring made it public.
pressure: Still holding on. No surrender speech prepared.

battle: Tissue wall! One sheet at a time still adds up!
Box corner push! I'm more than just the tissues!
足をばたつかせて回避！ 風で紙が先に逃げた！
aside: Movie night invitation. I was listed under supplies.
花粉の季節だけ、家族の中心にいる気がする。
pressure: Last sheet! Please stop looking for a spare box!

battle: Sugar-spine shield! This isn't the tasting session!
Curling up! Even sweet little spikes can sting!
小さい足で反撃！ 甘いだけの歩き方じゃない！
aside: 友達の誕生日に行ったら、ケーキの上が指定席だったの。
Birthday party seat assigned. On top of the cake.
pressure: Spikes remaining! One more try before I melt!

battle: Tail turning! Even a headwind is fun!
Paper-ear guard! Can we leave water out of this?
ぴょんとかわす！ しっぽが回りすぎて向きが変わった！
aside: Renewable energy. Powered by hourly treats.
散歩で風向計になった。電柱の情報も欲しかったのに。
pressure: Still spinning! I'll make my own tailwind!

battle: Dew-wing guard. Even a drop can carry weight.
A quiet reply. I don't need to raise my voice.
藍の影へかわす。夜と同じ色でよかったわ。
aside: Overtime at dawn. At least the dew is beautiful.
露を集める朝だけ、残業の意味が少しきれいなの。
pressure: Dew fallen. I can still make it through the night.

battle: Layers ready! I've had years to build these up!
Round-belly roll! There's strength in soy milk!
薄皮をずらしてかわすぞ。剥がすのとは違うぞ！
aside: More depth, they said. I'm entirely made of surfaces.
年輪じゃないよ。湯葉の層で年齢を当てないで。
pressure: One sheet left! Thin, but in it for the long haul!

battle: Lid closed. Gentlemen, kindly keep your heads down.
A polite little push. Polite needn't mean light.
一歩退いてかわします。割れる仕事はお断りです。
aside: 六名様で出勤したのに、帰りは一名様になりました。世知辛い。
Tenants: six eggs. Please knock gently.
pressure: Last room occupied. Kindly postpone the vacancy notice.

battle: Scrub guard! That fist could use a good wash!
Washboard chest! I'm used to a little friction!
親方の踏ん張りだ！ 泡で滑るのは若い衆の仕事だ！
A rapid scrub! Even your guard's getting a clean start!
胸板の溝で止める！ 縦にも横にも年季が入ってる！
aside: Automatic washer arrived. I challenged it to push-ups.
『昔ながら』の看板で仕事が増えた。腕は二本のままだぞ。
Old methods. New muscles. Same stubborn boss.
pressure: Grooves wearing down. My spirit isn't!
最後の一揉みだ！ 干される前に、おれが決める！

battle: Silver turn. Come faster than the tide!
Black-and-white guard. This sea isn't yours to take.
水を蹴って上へ抜ける。足元を見ている暇はないぞ。
aside: Silver blade. Now the fish market keeps calling.
ショーの拍手と戦いの合図、たまに似ていて困る。
pressure: I can still read the tide. One last full-body strike!

battle: Upside-down reply! There's more than one way to stand out!
Long-back guard! I've handled more stubborn heels than that!
くるっとかわす！ 床が上でも気にしない！
aside: 『地に足をつけろ』と言われた。足を入れる手伝いが仕事だよ。
Keep my feet on the ground? I help with other people's.
pressure: Still hanging on! The result's what I'm turning upside down!

battle: Honey trap! Unplanned, but I'm taking the credit!
Jar guard! No extra cracks, thank you!
蜜の拳で返す！ お返しも手にくっつくよ！
aside: Sweet sales. Sticky bookkeeping.
蜂の会計士が来た。床の蜜まで棚卸しされた。
pressure: Still dripping! That last drop is mine to use!

battle: Thread guard. Every touch sends me a message.
Quick spark. I wait for prey, not for permission.
八本の脚でかわす。手数の計算は得意かしら。
aside: Go wireless? You do realize I run a web business?
ネットの接続障害、だいたい私の昼寝が原因よ。
pressure: Thin thread. Connection still active.

battle: Paper wall! Let's make a mess of your view!
Pointed-paper punch! Those folds were made with care!
ひらひらっとかわす。重力にはちょっと待ってもらう！
aside: 掃除係と共演NGになった。ぼくはずっと祝ってるだけなのに。
Confetti first. Cleanup committee can catch up later.
pressure: Not scrap paper! I've still got an act to finish!

battle: Snow-tail guard. There's warmth behind all this white.
A tiny step. A serious little challenge.
雪の陰へかわす。足跡までは消せないけれど。
aside: Acorns hidden in snow. Spring me can handle the search.
雪景色の集合写真、名前だけ大きく書かれたわ。
pressure: Tail still wide. I'll stay till the last snow melts.

battle: Rock-salt fist! Take that with more than a pinch!
Big-grain guard! Size does make a difference here!
地を踏んで返す。溶かすなら川ごと持ってこい！
aside: Salt of the earth. Quite a lot of it, actually.
人事評価が『塩対応』だった。常に通常営業だ。
pressure: One grain left! Still too big to brush aside!

battle: Feather guard. Pillow service opens after the battle.
Little wings. I'll put my back into it.
首を回してよける。目はちゃんと開けてるつもり。
aside: 夜ふかしを叱られた。ぼくのお昼は、いつなんだろう。
Bedtime again? My schedule seems to confuse everyone.
pressure: Still awake. Please don't make the room any cozier.

battle: Vines ready! Could at least one follow the plan?
Vine counterattack! That's my pot! Wrong direction!
根を踏ん張る！ 引っ越しは今じゃない！
aside: Low-maintenance plant. Nobody counted the arms.
自分で水やりをしたら、自分に見つめられて緊張した。
pressure: New shoots left! Everyone, same direction this time!

battle: Ruby plates locked. One hit won't be enough.
Horn charge! Stop the ground if you want me stopped!
低い爪で踏ん張る。宝石の土台は揺らがない。
aside: Remove my armor? That's rather personal. It's my skin.
赤信号で立ち止まったら、仲間が俺の後ろで渋滞した。
pressure: Mark the armor. You won't get beyond it yet.

battle: Crunchy guard! Tough to chew, tougher to beat!
Wooden spear ready! Trained at the edge of the forest!
ひだを畳んで回避！ どこが前かは秘密だ！
aside: Wood ear meets jellyfish. Neither booked the right room.
キクラゲとクラゲの合同研修、集合場所が決まらねえ。
pressure: Still crunchy! I've got another round in me!

battle: Clear umbrella. A wall you can see through still stops things.
A turn of the handle. Smiling won't keep you dry.
ふわっと浮いてかわす。足元の水たまりもお友達なの。
aside: 天使と思われてお願いされた。降水確率までは変えられないの。
Take a rain check? I've already brought the weather.
pressure: Umbrella open. I'll stay for the last of the rain.

battle: Pedals moving! I'll beat you by keeping at it!
Gear-shell guard! I've taken plenty of long routes!
ペダルを逆に返す！ あっ、戻っちゃった！
aside: 電動にしようか迷って、充電中もペダルを踏んでた。
Electric upgrade considered. Pedaled while the battery charged.
pressure: Heavy legs. One more turn. I'm not getting off.

battle: Lacquer wings. This defense has had time to set.
Long-legged step. No shortcuts through my guard.
黒いくちばしを返す。影より細い一筋だ。
aside: Museum visit. I was given a "Do not touch" sign.
千年の寿命より、毎日の艶出しのほうが気になる。
pressure: Less shine. No less dignity.

battle: Silk turn. The knot isn't where you think.
Pull harder. You'll only make the knot tighter.
尾を巻いてひと打ち。可愛い包装とは別の技よ。
aside: プレゼントに巻かれたら、箱のほうがあたしを警戒したの。
Gift wrapping. The box looked more nervous than the guest.
pressure: A few loose threads. Still not coming apart.

battle: Warm-belly guard! Are you trying to make me boil?
A heated reply. Nobles have pressure too, you know!
栓を締めて防ぐ！ 漏れるのは不満だけでよい！
aside: Keep my cool? Have you considered my profession?
冬だけ招待が増える。友情の季節性には抗議したい。
pressure: Still warm! I refuse to be left out in the cold!

battle: Drill forward! Rock or guard, I'll find a way through!
Steel-claw guard! A good job needs a steady hand!
ねじって抜けるぞ。直進だけが近道じゃねえ！
aside: Aim higher, they said. I'm starting with ground level.
昇進の面接で『上を目指せ』って。まず地上を目指す。
pressure: Still turning! This isn't going to be wasted effort!

battle: Star-steel bow deployed. I'll answer from beyond your reach.
Legs locked. The recoil is already in the plan.
弦を引き、返す。放つ前の静けさに用心せよ。
aside: 狙いを定める研修で、全員が私の後ろへ移動した。
Aim high. Preferably somewhere without a ceiling.
pressure: Spare shot ready. The target hasn't changed.

battle: Plum-wing guard. Even the smallest flower matters.
A step from the branch. Spring can wait. I won't.
ちょんと横へかわす。香りだけは置いていくね。
aside: Picnic guard duty. Somehow, a rice ball went missing.
梅は咲いたか、と毎朝聞かれる。わたしの予定より人気なのね。
pressure: Spring will come. I'll hold on till the last blossom.

battle: Castle magnets, gather! Your sword may change sides!
Tower fist! Stop assuming castles stay in one place!
極を返して防ぐ。押せば近づくとは限らぬ！
Blue walls, push back! Admission has not been granted!
赤き塔よ、引き寄せよ！ 接近戦も余の間合いだ！
aside: Helmet inspection. Everyone was already attached to the wall.
騎士団の鉄兜が全て城壁へ貼りついた。点呼は楽であった。
Attracting talent. The iron helmets came first.
pressure: Still magnetic. You won't pull my dignity off that easily.
最後の塔まで立て！ 城主の芯は、まだ磁石より硬いぞ！

battle: Porcelain scales. This guard was forged in the kiln.
Blue patterns turning. Don't let the decoration distract you.
長い尾で空を押さえる。細い隙も通さぬわい。
Kiln-fired charge! White doesn't mean weak!
磁器の輪を重ねる。わしの体は、どこも守りじゃ。
aside: The expert called it damage. I called it experience.
鑑定士は傷を嫌う。わしは戦った跡として好いておるがの。
Family treasure. The museum keeps asking where I'm going.
pressure: Cracked, but still a dragon. Hear the final note.
砕けるには早いわい。千年の白を、ここで曇らせはせぬ！

battle: Night-blossom veil. Your strike can wait on the other side.
Dark-branch reply. Do look beyond the flowers.
はらりと影へ。月のない場所にも、道はあります。
A blossom storm. Beauty still requires a safe distance.
夜の冠で受けます。月明かりだけはお通ししましょう。
aside: Short blooming season. Exceptionally long committee meetings.
散るのが早いと言われますが、会議だけは長く咲く国ですわ。
More invitations. Not enough chairs. A growing problem.
pressure: Petals lost. The queen remains.
最後の一花まで舞います。幕を下ろす役は、わたくしですわ。

battle: Boom! That should cover the opening remarks!
Red-belly guard! Handle the explosives with respect!
導火線返し！ じわじわ来るほど派手になるぞ！
Another burst! You're part of the show now!
総長の踏ん張り！ 打ち上がる前には土台が要るんだ！
aside: Budget went up in smoke. Accounting wasn't impressed.
雨天中止のお知らせを花火で出したら、誰も帰らなかった。
Big finale planned. Small print still unread.
pressure: Not damp yet! I've saved the biggest one!
どかーんと締めるぞ！ ただし負けたとは、まだ言ってねえ！

battle: Pwaa! That wasn't a reply. That was the attack!
Bell-nose guard! Please don't blow into the opponent!
足でかわす！ 指づかいは合ってるのに向きが違う！
aside: Itchy nose. The solo became experimental.
演奏中に鼻がむずむずした。曲が勝手に現代音楽になった。
pressure: Breath left! One last note, right or wrong!

battle: Sand below. A low center of gravity helps.
Walking your way. Patience is part of the attack.
くるんとかわす。時間まで戻った気がする！
aside: 遅刻したからひっくり返した。でも約束は戻らなかった。
Turned myself over. The missed appointment stayed missed.
pressure: One grain left. I'm not calling time yet!

battle: Roll-ear guard! Pull gently. I'd like to stay in one piece!
Little-paw punch! I'll earn my snack first!
ころんとよけるよ。焼き目のほうは向けないの。
aside: Smells like a bakery. Hugs like a bear.
抱っこされたら『パン屋の匂い』って。くま屋だよ。
pressure: Still standing! There's more to me than the ears!

battle: Record guard. Scratches will not be forgotten.
One wing spin. Don't expect the same old tune!
針先をよけて踏み込む。音飛びほどの速さだ！
aside: Old records. Young bird. Stop mixing those up.
古い曲が好きなだけだ。年齢まで古く数えるなよ。
pressure: Still spinning! This groove has another song in it!

battle: Glass-panel guard. Pretty doesn't mean easy to break.
A little splash back. The rain stopped, not my feet.
光へ跳んでかわす。虹のほうを見ちゃった？
aside: 教会の窓と間違えられたわ。わたし、閉店しないのだけれど。
Mistaken for a window. Opening hours were requested.
pressure: Still hopping. The last raindrop hasn't dried yet.

battle: Smooth dodge! The knot is an artistic choice!
Knot strike! First, let me identify my arms!
麺を広げて足止め！ つゆなしでも滑るからな！
aside: Tied up at work. Also tied up trying to leave.
そばにいてって言われた。食品としての意味じゃないよね？
pressure: One noodle connected. I'm not falling apart yet!

battle: Dough guard! Push now. I'll rise to the challenge!
Soft-fist punch! Don't get too comfortable!
ころんと回避！ 打ち粉は砂ぼこりじゃないよ！
aside: 大きくなれって言われて頑張ったら、冷蔵庫に入れられた。
Growing as requested. Then they put me in the fridge.
pressure: Still rising! There's more air where that came from!

battle: Amber-wing sweep! Transparent doesn't mean there's a gap!
Little sting. A different department from honey collection.
六本の足でかわす！ 足並みは意外と揃ってるの！
aside: Flower-to-flower career moves. My resume became a bouquet.
働き蜂って呼ぶなら、休む蜂の担当も決めてほしいわ。
pressure: Still buzzing! One more flower to visit!

battle: Whoa, bright! Was I pointing the right way?
Light punch! Wait, my actual fist is over here!
横によけるぞ！ 足元を照らし忘れた！
aside: Looking for someone. Turns out they were looking for me.
探し物を照らしてたら、探されてたのがおれだった。
pressure: Still on! Now, which end faces the battle?

battle: Flower-collar guard. Bedding is the other department.
A little push. Training before hibernation, apparently.
お腹をひいてかわす。あと少し、ひけるはず。
aside: Three alarm clocks. All hibernating beautifully.
目覚ましを三つ買ったわ。全部、冬眠の仲間になったの。
pressure: Still awake. I'm saving the long sleep for afterward.

battle: Triangle guard! Three corners must count for something!
Nori-arm punch! Hands washed. Courage ready.
ころんと逃げる！ 三角だから途中で止まっちゃう！
aside: 具がないって言われた。ぼくの勇気は見えないんだね。
No filling? My courage just doesn't show on the menu.
pressure: Every last grain! I'm keeping myself together!

battle: Broccoli-head guard! Mind the knowledge stored in there!
Lab-coat turn! Time to test the hypothesis!
細い脚でかわす。仮説では、この角度が安全！
aside: Looks like a brain. Somehow, that means taking the minutes.
助手なのに、先生の弁当で見かけた顔が多すぎる。
pressure: New hypothesis. Same conclusion: I can still win!

battle: Branch-wing guard. It sways. It doesn't break.
A quiet peck. I don't spend all day sunbathing.
葉影へかわす。光の模様を読んでみたまえ。
aside: Bird resting area. I appear to be the furniture.
昼寝の写真が『森の一部』として売られていた。
pressure: Branch alive. Bird present. Carry on.

battle: Neck dodge! My head got there before the rest!
Joints folded! Compact is a perfectly good battle style!
長い首で返す！ 手より頭が働くタイプ！
aside: 背伸びしたら天井に着いた。身の丈に合った部屋がない。
Flexible neck. The schedule refuses to follow its example.
pressure: One joint left! I'll keep my head up!

battle: Cat dodge! That's a whole new level of bad posture!
Body coil! This isn't the cuddling service!
ひげのリボンで止める！ ほどくと機嫌が変わるぞ！
aside: 猫の狭い所好きと、蛇の長さが合わさって、引っ越しが終わらない。
Meow or hiss? Call it jazz and leave me alone.
pressure: Tail still here! I can drag this out all night!

battle: Sack guard. Onions, kindly wake up and help.
Mesh stretched. Seeing through it isn't getting through it.
重たい足で一歩よける。まぶたのほうは後にしよう。
aside: Everyone's crying already. I haven't started the story.
徹夜明けではない。玉ねぎの層くらい、寝たはずなんだ。
pressure: Still upright. We'll discuss the tears after the fight.

battle: Pearl-shell guard. There's depth behind that thin light.
A quiet turn. The seabed taught me this step.
殻の陰へかわす。輝きは少し残ってしまうけれど。
aside: Pearl-like skin? Actually, that's my house.
真珠のような肌って。肌ではなく、家なのよ。
pressure: Shell still closing. I'll keep the last light safe.

battle: Folded-horn guard! More complicated than it looks!
Paper-hoof charge! Imagine the ground shaking!
谷折りでかわす！ 山折りだったら頭が下がらねえ！
aside: 手順書に『簡単』とあった。おれの出生に三時間かかった。
"Easy project." My birth took three hours.
pressure: More folds. Same stubborn bull. Not beaten yet!

battle: Powder-puff guard. Please remain calm about the cloud.
A neat little step. The finish matters.
くるっとかわす。左右の眉を揃える動体視力さ。
aside: 散歩の前にメイクをしたら、散歩の時間が終わった。
Makeup done. Lovely. We've run out of walking time.
pressure: Still holding. My makeup and my pride.

battle: Ladle-belly guard! We'll toast with fists today!
Handle swing! That's more than your usual serving!
丸い面で押し返す！ 宴の段取り同様、強引にいく！
One great scoop! I'll serve your attack right back!
部長の腹芸だ！ 腹はないが、この丸みでどうにかする！
aside: Three days on party tricks. Three minutes on the agenda.
余興の準備に三日。会議の準備に三分。時間配分が逆だって？
Optional party. Apparently, I was the only option.
pressure: Not the closing speech! My cup isn't empty yet!
最後の一杯まで勝負！ 二次会より先に、逆転だ！

battle: Crossed blades. Even the escape route gets cut.
One flash. Regret can wait until after you blink.
青い刃で受ける。片腕が空いていると思うな。
aside: Fast work praised. Deadline shortened. Lesson learned.
速い仕事を褒められた翌日から、納期だけ短くなった。
pressure: Two blades remain. One breath will be enough.

battle: Grab first! You don't have to be cooked to be caught!
Both jaws ready! Mind where you put those hands!
ばねで跳んで返す！ 離した反動が大事なんだ！
aside: Barbecue invitation. Guest list and equipment list. Both.
テーブルマナーを学んだら、オレの置き場所が増えた。
pressure: Still gripping! I'm not letting go of this last chance!

battle: Moon-ring guard. A circle has no loose end.
One foreleg turn. A gap thinner than moonlight is enough.
輪を傾けてかわす。正面だけを追うな。
aside: Lunar messenger appointed. Travel expenses still under review.
満月の日だけ写真映えすると。私の勤務態度は毎日同じだ。
pressure: Even a crescent keeps moving. So will I.

battle: Booming guard! Hollow things make an impressive noise!
Big-face attack! The glare arrives before the blade!
風をよんでかわす！ 強風だけは、読まなくても来る！
aside: 鎧の見積もりが安すぎる？ 大きさだけなら将軍級だ！
General-sized confidence. Contents sold separately.
pressure: Empty inside! Absolutely packed with attitude!

battle: Full bloom! Don't spend the whole battle looking up!
Stem feet planted. Flowers have staying power too!
ひと回りしてよけるわ。傘の下も通行止めよ！
aside: Rain cover costs extra. I'm in the blooming business.
顔が見えないって？ 満開の笑顔を見せてるつもりなのよ。
pressure: One petal left! Enough for one more lively dance!

battle: Noodle armor! Getting tangled is part of the defense!
A long reply! You won't need to wait three minutes!
湯気にまぎれてかわす！ 蓋を取るには早い！
aside: 出陣の時間を三分間違えたら、兵の腰がなくなった。
Three-minute plan. Five-minute meeting. Disaster.
pressure: Still firm! I'm not letting this drag on!

battle: Blue-glass guard. Transparent isn't the same as passable.
A clean cut through water. Can you follow the glass edge?
長い尾で潮を変える。追う流れは、そこではない。
aside: Aquarium visit. They asked for my tank installation quote.
暑い日の写真だけ、急に依頼が増える。見た目の涼しさか。
pressure: Blue still clear. Even the last crack will carry light.

battle: Bead guard! Odors aren't the only things I absorb!
Small-bead punch! Quiet jobs can take real strength!
つるんとかわす。器の外は思ったより広いわね。
aside: 存在感を消してって。匂いと一緒に扱わないでくれる？
Disappear into the background? Please don't treat me like an odor.
pressure: Beads remaining! I'm not clearing out just yet!

battle: Metal-wing cut. Speed comes with weight this time.
Feathers locked. Don't assume every bird is lightweight.
空へ切り返す。上を向いた時には、もう遅い。
aside: Built a nest. The branch moved out.
空港の検査で羽を外せと言われた。徒歩で帰れというのか。
pressure: Chipped blades. Full speed. Watch the last wing.

battle: Zip shut! No traffic beyond the teeth!
Jaw open! The teeth speak before I do!
背を曲げてよける！ 噛み合う歯は全部武器だ！
aside: Keep it zipped? For once, excellent advice.
口が固い会議に呼ばれた。潤滑油だけ持参した。
pressure: Still zipping! Every tooth is staying in this fight!

battle: Carpet dodge! The nose is just a distraction!
Layered-cloth guard. The spice is built in.
くるんと返す！ 辛口の一撃、お待ちどう！
aside: 空飛ぶじゅうたんに憧れた。離陸前に近所が腹を空かせた。
Flying carpet prepared. The neighbors prepared their plates.
pressure: Still fragrant! I've got one more spicy turn left!

battle: Star-feather guard. Even a thin night has depth.
One-leg turn. Balance doesn't require a pair.
長い首で返す。優雅な線にも終点はあるのよ。
aside: One-leg fitness trend. My ordinary Tuesday has a name now.
ドレスの裾直しより、脚の寸法説明のほうが長いわ。
pressure: Posture held. I'll meet your gaze at star height.

battle: Gate lowered. Your momentum stops here.
Stone-fist reply. Gates are not limited to defense.
両脚を据える。通す道は、私が決める。
aside: Open up, they said. Everyone walked straight through.
会議の結論は『風通しをよく』。格子は元から空いている。
pressure: Last stone standing. You'll have to earn this entrance.

battle: Ha-ha! Good echo! That means I'm holding up!
Barrel roll! Laugh now. Dodge next!
底で踏ん張る！ 空っぽでも、軽く扱うなよ！
aside: Music audition. They drummed on me before reading my resume.
楽器の面接で、履歴書より先に腹を叩かれた。
pressure: Still ringing! Let me have the last laugh!

battle: Jellyfish guard. A little shelter. A little sting.
A drifting reply. Slow can still reach you.
虹色の尾をひくわ。追うなら、潮に置いていかれないで。
aside: 七色の予定表を作ったの。予定が全部、潮まかせだったわ。
Rainbow planner. Every appointment depends on the tide.
pressure: Still afloat. The last color hasn't faded.

battle: Lemon-blade reply. A sharp edge with a sharp taste.
Peel armor. Bitterness has taught me a few things.
きゅっと絞ってかわす。細くなるのも剣術さ。
aside: 爽やかな男と言われるけど、傷口には向かない性格だね。
When life gives you lemons, request a fencing partner.
pressure: Juice remaining! I'll squeeze out one last chance!

battle: Moon-armor guard. Learn its weight before chasing the light.
Low strike. This ground is not changing hands.
丸まって守る。逃げではない、全身の盾だ。
aside: Armor polishing offered. They reached the underside by sunset.
行動が硬い？ 甲冑のせいだけにはできないな。
pressure: One plate left. That's the one that matters now.

battle: Bubble wall! Getting through one doesn't mean you're out!
Whistle reply! The splash might arrive before the sound!
大耳で受け流す。波の話は全部聞いてるぞ！
aside: 静かに暮らしたくて海底へ来た。泡の音が近すぎた。
Quiet life under the sea. The bubbles moved in too.
pressure: One bubble left! I'll make myself heard!

battle: Blue antlers ready. Sky color. Stone strength.
A quiet hoofstep. Can you read even that?
光の陰へかわす。透明な場所も、隠れ家になる。
aside: Sky photograph. I ended up as the color sample.
天気の話で安心されるけど、僕も雨の日はわからないよ。
pressure: Blue still clear. My eyes will stay that way too.

battle: Cloud wings open. My sky takes more than one strike to cross.
Royal talons. No land beneath me, but plenty of weight.
雲影へ抜ける。君の視線より、高く広く。
One white-wing turn. The rising wind answers to me.
雲壁を重ねる。見えるからと、道とは限らぬ。
aside: National border drawn. The clouds relocated it overnight.
『地に足のついた政策を』と。まず、地を持ってこさせよう。
The sky isn't the limit. It's where I hold meetings.
pressure: Clouds thinning. The sky remains. So do I.
最後の一雲まで翔ける！ 王の影を、ここで地へ落としはせぬ！

battle: Copper spear forward! I'll meet that guard head-on!
Shield planted. Even a heated strike stops here!
脚を返し、突く。大きな鎧にも、速い一歩はある！
A sweeping spear! Don't expect a polite warning!
赤い盾で受け切る。傷を重ねたぶん、覚悟は厚い！
aside: Sunny camp chosen. By noon, everyone had moved away from me.
日当たりのよい陣地を選んだ。昼には全員、某から離れた。
Armor polished. Soldiers exhausted. I owe them a rest.
pressure: Copper still rings. I'll answer with the final blow.
某は倒れぬ！ 最後の火照りまで、勝負に注ぐ！

battle: Flower-sleeve guard. Soft layers can make a firm answer.
A floral reply. Sweet scents can have strong roots.
裾をひいてかわす。踏んでよい花は、一輪もありませんの。
Flower storm! The sightseeing part of this battle is over.
幾重の花弁で守ります。最後の奥まで、届きますか。
aside: Flowers as a gift? I shall consult my wardrobe.
千の花に役職をつけたら、名刺だけで庭が埋まりましたわ。
A thousand flowers. The business cards filled the garden.
pressure: One flower is enough. My courage won't wither.
最後の一輪まで咲き切ります。幕を閉じるのは、勝負のあとですわ。

battle: Pot-lid guard! Behold the king of round defenses!
Spoon-scepter strike! This is no tasting portion!
つまみを握って踏ん張る！ そこは弱点でなく王冠だ！
Great lid flip! Even the kitchen wasn't ready for this!
蒸気を閉じ込める守り！ 圧力は味方にもなるのだ！
aside: Demon hunters arrived. Asked whether I came with a matching pot.
魔王討伐の冒険者が、サイズの合う鍋も探しておった。
Fear the lid. Compliments to the soup can wait.
pressure: Not dented! Well, the metal is. The pride isn't!
最後のポコポンを響かせよう！ 吾輩の蓋は、まだ閉じぬぞ！

battle: I've got more air than I know what to do with.
That wasn't a wrong note. That was a warning.
拳も音もためてるぞ。ため息だけは先に出しちゃった！
aside: 顔認証に失敗した。朝と夕方で、ほっぺの幅が違うんだ。
Face recognition? My cheeks have changed since breakfast.
pressure: I'm running out of breath, not ideas.

battle: I brought my own rain. No need to check the forecast.
Take your time. I'm setting a personal record here.
つのを伸ばして距離を測るよ。近すぎたら、ゆっくり逃げる！
aside: My hat says rain. The forecast can say whatever it likes.
急いで来たよ。出発したのは、きのうだけど。
pressure: Could we keep the attacks down to a light drizzle?

battle: Keep it down. I'm trying to fight in my sleep.
I heard that attack. I'd rather not hear another.
耳当てを閉じて守る。静かすぎて寝たら、起こして。
aside: 睡眠用の音楽を選ぶ仕事で、選曲した記憶が一曲もない。
Noise canceled. Now cancel my alarm.
pressure: I'm still playing. Just on low battery.

battle: Unwrap my tail? That leaves my neck out in the cold.
There's more to this scarf than meets the eye.
くるりとかわす！ 長いしっぽの着地だけ、少し待って！
aside: The care label says, 'Ask the owner first.'
洗濯表示は『本人に相談』って書いてある。
pressure: I need a comeback, and a tighter knot.

battle: Don't mistake these soft curls for a soft opponent.
Peaceful doesn't mean defenseless, dear.
角を合わせましょう。やさしく見えても、譲れない場所はあるの。
aside: I wear a peace symbol. My schedule says otherwise.
メェ、冠をサラダと呼んだのは、どなたかしら。
pressure: I'm keeping my crown, even if I lose my cool.

battle: I tied this knot myself. That should worry both of us.
Looking sharp is half the battle. I hope.
首もとを狙っても無駄さ。おれ自身が、もう絡まってる！
aside: 服装自由の会社に行ったら、存在そのものが自由すぎると言われた。
Casual Friday? That's a personal attack.
pressure: Hold it together, knot. I'm counting on you.

battle: After you! Wait, I meant through the door!
Being small doesn't mean I have to think small.
しっぽで足場をつかむよ。ぼくにも、ちょっと強いところがある！
aside: 蝶ネクタイをしたら大人になると思った。おやつは増えなかった。
I dressed like a grown-up. The snacks stayed the same.
pressure: I may wobble, but my manners won't slip.

battle: If it doesn't fit, I'll call it lost property.
This pencil isn't just for taking notes.
チャックを閉めて防御！ 中から開けるの、誰か手伝って！
aside: I swallowed an eraser. There goes my whole schedule.
ぼくの収納力より、先生の配るプリントの方が強い。
pressure: Keep it together! That includes everything inside me!

battle: Aim at the rabbit, not the lovely scent I left behind.
Careful with the seams. They keep me in one piece.
ふわりと近づくわね。香りだけの相手だと油断したかしら。
aside: 眠りにいい香りを作ったら、試作品の会議が全員欠席だったわ。
My relaxing scent put the whole meeting to sleep.
pressure: The scent may fade. The impression won't.

battle: Follow the paint trail. If you can keep up!
Your defense could use a fresh coat.
ふたを閉じてガード。乾いたら、開かなくなるけど！
aside: All my colors end up brown. It's my signature style.
色を混ぜすぎると、全部『おいら色』になる。だいたい茶色。
pressure: One brushful left. Better make it count!

battle: Lunch isn't over until I say it's over!
You can't rush a good sandwich. Or a good defense.
レタスの層で衝撃を散らすぞ。栄養の偏りも、散らしたい！
aside: お弁当の中身を聞かれた。自分の紹介から始めるべきかな。
Everyone gets a lunch break. Except the lunch.
pressure: The bag's a mess. The filling's still fighting.

battle: A loose thread. That's all I need.
Your attack has a flaw. I know where to pull.
この針は飾りではない。背中から近づくなら、なおさら。
aside: Cloud orders are always vague. 'Make it fluffy,' they say.
雨漏りの苦情が来た。雲としては、正常に動いている。
pressure: I won't leave this fight unfinished.

battle: Don't judge a fan before it opens up!
Feel that breeze? It's not on your side.
骨をそろえて構えるぞ。一本でもサボると、見栄えが悪い！
aside: The electric fan kept shaking its head at my proposal.
扇風機と腕相撲した。相手がずっと首を振って、話にならない。
pressure: I'm not folding just yet!

battle: Try keeping up with my shadow first.
This cape hides more than a fine pair of hooves.
静かな一歩を侮るな。走り出す前にも、勝負は動いている。
aside: I practiced looking windswept. Mostly, I waited for wind.
ポニーという響きだけで、子供用だと決めないでくれ。
pressure: Even a quiet evening can bring a second wind.

battle: No thanks. You can take that attack right back.
I'm peeling potatoes. My patience is wearing thin.
横向きの刃で止める！ この姿勢から動くの、めんどくさい！
aside: じゃがいもの皮をむく会議に呼ばれた。議題の時点で帰りたかった。
I wasn't cut out for potato duty.
pressure: I'm down to one very thin excuse.

battle: Hot attacks? My wings aren't ready for the oven!
Golden outside. Please be gentle with the fluffy inside.
くるんと体当たり！ 三日月の先っぽは、ちょっととがってる！
aside: Takeaway? No, thank you. I can walk home.
羽をはばたくと、いいにおいでおなかがすいちゃう。
pressure: A little more butter, and I'm back in the air!

battle: Was that me you aimed at, or my reflection?
Being transparent doesn't mean I'm not here.
水のきらめきを返すわね。まぶしさも、私の守りの一つ。
aside: The landlord asked about sunlight. I asked about puddles.
透明な私にも、見せたくない寝ぐせはあるのよ。
pressure: Even a cracked wing can catch the light.

battle: Don't get carried away. That's my job!
A sour twist should wipe that smile off your face.
いぼいぼの鎧だぜ。見た目の食感からして、手強いだろ！
aside: 漬け込まれて丸くなったと思った？ むしろ、さらにとがったぜ。
They said I'd mellow with age. I'm getting sharper.
pressure: Still got a whole jar of confidence left!

battle: Shiny, yes. Candy, no. Please remember that.
You can chase the sparkle. I'll roll the other way.
ころころ、ごつん！ ぶつかった方も、なんだかあったかくなるね！
aside: They put a price tag on my nap.
宝石屋さんのケースにいたら、お昼寝に値札がついてた。
pressure: Don't count this little glow out yet.

battle: My defense potion! Wait, that's my own filling!
Let's see what happens. That's a scientific plan, isn't it?
コルクを締めるのじゃ。ここが開くと、ひらめきまで漏れる！
Don't shake me. The conclusion isn't settled yet.
未知の液体を発射！ 正体は、未来のわしが説明する！
aside: Safety first. Then I remember what I was doing.
研究費の申請に『だいたい紫』と書いたら、差し戻されたぞ。
Results may vary. Especially when I'm the experiment.
pressure: There's still something left at the bottom. Probably power.
フラスコが震える！ 失敗の予感ではない、逆転の泡立ちじゃ！

battle: Show some respect for the teeth. They're the real deal.
Eyes on the claws? You're missing the bigger picture.
結晶の肩で受ける。欠けても、切れる面が増えるだけだ。
aside: 夜のかくれんぼで、赤い目だけ先に見つかるんだよな。
I'd be great at hide-and-seek if my eyes stopped glowing.
pressure: Don't look so pleased. These claws still work.

battle: One shoe. That's all it takes to make an entrance!
Watch your step. Mine's a little unpredictable.
片足で踏ん張るぜ！ もう片方は、最初から持ってきてない！
aside: 靴屋で相方を探したら、左右どっちか聞かれて困った。
Left or right? I'm still figuring that out.
pressure: No backup shoe. Guess I'd better stay standing!

battle: Look closer. Your mistakes are bigger than you think.
Come a little closer. I promise a thorough inspection.
じろりと守る。わしの目線は、虫めがねより厳しいぞ。
aside: I need a magnifier to find my reading glasses.
老眼鏡を探すためのルーペを探して、一日が終わった。
pressure: I can still spot a weakness through this crack.

battle: Not every bubble comes with a flying fish inside.
Water or air, I know my way around.
ぱしゃっと水の壁！ 当たると、君も少し虹色だよ！
aside: 飛行機のマイルと水泳の記録、両方つかないかな。
Can I earn air miles and swimming medals at once?
pressure: Small bubbles. One last leap that's anything but small.

battle: Front wheels locked. The road may need repairs.
Sharp turn. Feelings will not affect the steering.
四輪同時ニ反撃。足並ミハ、機械的ニソロッテイマス。
aside: Vehicle inspection sent me to the insect department.
タイヤ交換中ニ飛ブ案ハ、会議デ却下サレマシタ。
pressure: Low power. Losing is not part of the saving plan.

battle: The lid's closed. Take it up with the manager.
I'm always this hot. Don't take it personally!
格子の守りを突破してみな！ あとが残るのは、覚悟しろよ！
aside: One star for my face? You were supposed to taste the food!
レビュー星一つ。『顔が怖い』。味の話をしてくれ！
pressure: I refuse to finish this fight half-baked!

battle: A step back can still be part of my dance.
Beauty is no excuse for dropping your guard.
一歩引いて構えます。引き際まで、こちらが決めるのです。
aside: I'm not overdressed. The scenery is underdressed.
ほほ、派手ではございません。背景の色が、少し足りないのです。
pressure: Feathers may fall. My standards won't.

battle: No gaps in this defense. Please ignore the three holes.
I could roll faster. But the sword deserves a turn.
ストライクを狙う！ 君は一本しか立ってないから、集中できる！
aside: 靴のサイズを聞かれるたび、球の直径を答えてしまう。
They asked my shoe size. I gave them my diameter.
pressure: A curveball won't make me bend the rules.

battle: Tears already? Save the applause for later!
That's real mustard. The yellow isn't just for show.
黄色い角で受ける！ からし色じゃなくて、本物だい！
aside: I'm popular beside the food. Apparently, that's my limit.
おでんの横では大人気。主役になろうとすると、止められる。
pressure: Wrong wind direction! Now I'm crying too!

battle: Let me reflect on that attack. Right back at you.
What you aimed at is already a different view.
銀の裾を広げるよ。背後まで鏡になると、君は忙しいね。
aside: 会議で存在感が薄いと言われた。全員、私で身だしなみを確認していた。
They called me invisible. Then checked their hair in me.
pressure: A few wrinkles won't spoil the final reflection.

battle: Road closed! Unless you're here to help dig.
Cracks in my back? That's just the local road map.
地面を掘って回り込む！ 近道のはずが、地下二階まで来た！
aside: They said aim higher. I work underground.
地下の仕事なのに、上司はいつも『もっと上を目指せ』って。
pressure: Still drilling. There's a way through this somewhere!

battle: Paper armor. My promise still stands.
Mind your fingers. This blade has a familiar sting.
翼をたたんで一閃！ 展開図に、この動きは載っておらぬ！
aside: I followed every instruction. Then added my own final fold.
説明書どおりの人生。最後の一折りだけ、我流でござる。
pressure: I bend paper, not my principles!

battle: Which skirt did you aim at? I've got several backups.
Even my run-up is part of the choreography!
裾を重ねて受ける！ 衣装の重さが、今日は味方ね！
aside: 本番五分前に衣装替え。着替え終わるころには、次の公演だったわ。
My costume change lasted longer than the show.
pressure: Shaking knees? I'm just keeping the beat!

battle: Shell closed. This is defense, not a lunch break.
Let's hope the cannon fires more than sea air today.
ごろごろ接近。砂浜の足跡なら、誰より幅がある。
aside: The car wash sent me to a fish shop.
貝柱は機密部品だ。そこだけは見学を断る。
pressure: Heavy shell. Still enough power for one more shot.

battle: Follow my footprints. The wind has other plans.
A graceful step still needs a firm landing.
ひづめをそろえて受けるよ。軽やかさにも、支えは必要でね。
aside: They said, 'Just a donkey.' I took that personally.
たてがみの維持費より、風向きを変える方が安そうだ。
pressure: I'll fix my mane after I've settled this.

battle: Cross that flame, and the blade gets there first.
Bring a light if you're planning to chase my shadow.
抜いた刀は戻さぬ……鞘の位置を、暗くて見失っただけだ。
aside: Even a dark organization wants a proper receipt.
闇の組織にも経費精算があった。領収書だけ、やけに白い。
pressure: The flame is fading. The blade hasn't lost its edge.

battle: I'm more worried about landing than your next attack!
I'm going with the wind. Let's call it a strategy.
ふわっとよけるよ。風任せだけど、作戦って呼んでいい？
aside: They told me to put down roots. I'm still airborne.
根菜なのに、根を下ろす許可が出ないんだ。
pressure: I'll stay up. Please keep the soil soft!

battle: Don't get lost in the view. That's my opening.
Cold feathers. A perfectly clear head.
細い氷の矢を返すわ。静かな攻撃ほど、よく届くものよ。
aside: They call me cold. I assume they mean the temperature.
冷たい対応と評判ね。室温の話なら、合っているけれど。
pressure: My wings may melt. My pride won't wash away.

battle: Time to move the ground beneath your feet!
Rust? That's experience showing. Probably.
シャベルを立てて壁にする！ 防御も掘削も、道具は一本だ！
aside: They asked me to dig deeper into my strengths.
完成予定図に穴がある？ そこがおれの担当だ！
pressure: One last scoop. Let's turn this fight around!

battle: I've put down roots. You're not moving me.
A hundred years of preparation won't fall to one blow.
木の葉のざわめきを聞け。これは風か、余の反撃か。
Every scar becomes another layer of armor.
根の先から力を集める。王の一歩は、森の一歩である。
aside: That meeting went on so long, I grew another ring.
森に紙の書類を持ち込む者よ。出身地を、少し考えよ。
You don't have permission to uproot me.
pressure: Broken branches. Unbroken roots. This season isn't over.
葉が散るたび、光は奥へ届く。最後の力も、そこから芽吹く。

battle: These scales have weathered more storms than you can imagine.
There's more to me than the face above the waves.
海流を編んで囲もう。逃げ道も、波の内側じゃ。
Beauty alone didn't earn me this throne.
白波を背に反撃じゃ。遠い海の力まで、受けてみせよ。
aside: I gave the pearl polishers a day off. Blissful silence.
涙が真珠になるというが、わらわは玉ねぎには近寄らぬ。
Deep water. Even deeper respect for the queen, please.
pressure: One pearl is enough to remind you who I am.
一粒残れば、真珠は真珠。わらわの誇りも同じことじゃ。

battle: Unexpected attacks have already been added to the schedule.
Every second counts. Particularly the one before my attack.
カチリ。君ノ動キヲ、一歯分先ニ読ンダ。
Precision and power. I see no need to choose.
バネヲ巻ク。一秒ノ間ニ、積ミ重ネタ力ヲ返ソウ。
aside: I shortened the agenda. They added another meeting.
歯車ノ一ツガ有給ヲ取ッタ。王国全体ガ三分遅レテイル。
Your move. I have all the time in the world.
pressure: Behind schedule. Not out of power.
最後ノ歯ガ残ル限リ、機巧王ハ噛ミ合イ続ケル。

battle: Make yourself comfortable. Getting out is another matter.
This cool side of the pillow isn't open to everyone.
枕を返すように身を返す。こっちが冷たい面なのじゃ。
Light as feathers. Heavy on authority.
王冠を起こして構えよう。寝たまま負けたら、夢見が悪いからの。
aside: I held the morning assembly in my dreams. Excellent attendance.
国民の睡眠時間を増やしたら、国会が一度も始まらぬのじゃ。
Five more minutes. Royal orders.
pressure: I'm losing my shape, not my royal dignity.
最後の綿まで、王の意地じゃ。今だけは、眠りに落ちてはならぬ。

battle: Wind me up. I'll handle the rest.
Stopping isn't included in the instructions!
くるくる旋回！ 止まる場所だけ、まだ習ってない！
aside: 目覚まし係に任命されたけど、先にネジを巻く係が必要だった。
I'm the alarm. Who's in charge of winding me?
pressure: One last turn. Let's make it a good one.

battle: One eye open is still better than none.
Easy with the drops. I've only got so many.
キャップを盾にするよ。開けたままの勇気には、限界がある！
aside: They told me to rest. I'm supposed to help them!
疲れ目相談の窓口で、ぼくが先に休憩を勧められた。
pressure: Blink, and you'll miss my last few drops.

battle: No use crying over spilled milk. Let's avoid the spilling.
A steady hand. That's how grown-ups handle a full cup.
泡のふたで守るよ。見た目より、しぶとい膜なんだ。
aside: I wiped my mustache. Nearly wiped out half my face.
寝る前にぼくを飲む？ ぼく自身は、いつ寝ればいいんだろう。
pressure: Still warm enough to see this through.

battle: You'd be safer over there. Oh. Wrong team.
Mind your fingers! I insist, even if we're fighting.
開いた腕で迎え撃つ！ その構え、つい直したくなりますね！
aside: Before I smooth things over, could someone oil me?
人間関係を円滑にする前に、私に油を差してください。
pressure: A little creaking won't stop me being helpful.

battle: Those aren't cheeks. That's a full-moon defense!
Count the leaves, not the cheek peeking out!
葉っぱをかぶってかくれる！ ほっぺが出てる？ そこは月だよ！
aside: Round face. Not always a sunny mood.
顔が丸いからって、いつも機嫌が満月とは限らないぞ。
pressure: Not quite a new moon yet. I've got more to give!

battle: Wait, we're starting? I haven't found my loose end!
Stick around. Getting free is the hard part.
ぐるぐる巻いて守る！ 巻かれるの、ぼく自身だった！
aside: I label everything 'Handle with care.' Someone label me!
取扱注意って書いて貼るのが仕事。ぼくにも貼ってほしい。
pressure: One roll left. I can't let this come apart now!

battle: Don't let the pattern distract you from the fox.
It's a dye, not a stain. There's a difference.
尾を重ねて守るの。染みじゃないわ、染めよ。そこ大事。
aside: 洗濯は別にしてね。白い雲を一つ、青くした前科があるの。
Wash separately. I once turned a white cloud blue.
pressure: My color may run. I won't.

battle: Hard outside. Still a softie on the inside.
If I fall over, can we call it a draw?
みぞみぞで受ける！ どこが正面か、あたちも時々わすれる！
aside: Forks on the table? Suddenly, I'm not hungry.
フォークが来るお店は、ちょっと緊張しちゃう。
pressure: I can still stand! Just don't hurry me.

battle: A quiet note makes you listen a little closer.
My shell is closed. My voice isn't gone.
珊瑚の足でくるり。波のリズムで、君の間合いを外すね。
aside: Nobody heard my quiet bell. Great idea, in theory.
海の音を聞くふりで、わたしのひとり言を聞いてない？
pressure: One faint ring can still get your attention.

battle: Three legs. You'd think that would be enough.
Stand still! My legs aren't doing their part.
レンズを向けて見切る！ あれ、ピントが背景に合っておる！
aside: Image stabilization. Apparently, shaky legs cost extra.
手ぶれ補正を買った。足ぶれは、対象外じゃった。
pressure: One last shot. Please stay in the frame.

battle: That wasn't a yawn. It was an aerial maneuver.
Soft wings. Surprisingly firm opinions about losing.
ぽてっと体当たり！ 着地は、ほっぺからでも大丈夫。
aside: I packed my cheek pouches with dreams. No snack space.
頬袋に夢を詰めたら、おやつが入らなくなっちゃった。
pressure: No drifting off until this fight is over.

battle: You're welcome to attack the hole. I'm not in it.
Any holes in your plan? I know what to look for.
ごまのつぶまで構える！ 小さくても、粒ぞろいなんだぜ。
aside: ドーナツの会に混ざったら、甘さの審査でばれちまった。
The doughnut club checked my sweetness. So much for that.
pressure: The hole isn't bigger. My options are just smaller.

battle: No footprints. You'll have to find another clue.
A hint of spring is enough to keep me going.
花の飾りを揺らして踏み込む。かわいいだけなら、森を渡れないわ。
aside: Spring arrived. My sneeze got there first.
花粉の季節も好きかって？ その質問、少し時間をちょうだい。
pressure: One last patch of snow. I'll find my way through.

battle: Please step off my nose when the ride ends.
My nose gets there first. I prefer a little warning.
首をそらしてかわすよ。鼻の先は、あとからついてくる！
aside: Blowing my nose takes longer than telling my life story.
風邪のときだけ、鼻をかむ作業が長編になる。
pressure: I'm tired right down to the tip of my nose.

battle: My eyes went left. I decided to try right.
The water's moving. Don't jump to conclusions about me.
きょろっと反撃！ どこを狙うか、自分でも目が追いつかない！
aside: I practiced eye contact. The goldfish really liked me.
アイコンタクトの練習で、金魚と先に仲よくなった。
pressure: Everything's spinning. I'm still watching how this ends.

battle: I'm smiling. That doesn't mean it didn't hurt!
A soft landing. Followed by a proper bounce!
あんこの芯で踏ん張るよ。中身のない笑顔じゃないもん！
aside: 笑顔の接客を頼まれた。お客さん、だいたいぼくを注文する。
They wanted service with a smile. Then ordered me.
pressure: Flattened, yes. Defeated? Not quite.

battle: Follow the light. Just remember I can move it.
Don't mistake that tail shadow for the whole squirrel.
草のかさで守るよ。火じゃないから、燃えなくて便利だね！
aside: Two acorns for the night shift? We need to talk.
ライトを消したら、ぼくの帰り道もなくなっちゃう。
pressure: A little light is still enough to finish the job.

battle: Delicate doesn't mean I'm about to snap.
Please allow a little room for the collar.
しゃなりと身をかわすわ。動くたびに、正装が広がりますの。
aside: Mother's Day is fully booked. When is my day off?
えりが顔より大きい？ 今日は少しだけ、控えめですのよ。
pressure: Fewer petals. The same upright posture.

battle: I pop up without warning. Even I get surprised.
Watch the wire. It's hotter than my temper.
こんがり反撃！ 今朝の怒りも、ちょうど焼けたところだ！
aside: My breakfast left for work before I did.
網の上で将来を語られると、話まで焦げそうになる。
pressure: One last jump. Let's keep this fight heated!

battle: A balanced defense. With all the essential nutrients!
Forks at the ready! Victory will be served shortly.
ボウルの腹で受けます。器の大きさなら、負けませんぞ！
I can chew and govern at the same time.
ドレッシングを回して反撃！ 今回だけ、味の濃い政策です！
aside: I ate the lettuce before we could discuss food distribution.
野菜不足の相談ですか。わたくしを見ながら言う勇気は評価します。
More greens. Less red tape. That's my policy.
pressure: Those last beans are my emergency budget.
大臣の器は空にしません！ 最後の一葉まで、お相手しますぞ！

battle: Four wings. Try counting them without losing track of me.
Thin armor. Solid training. Don't confuse the two.
キィン、一度も止まらず狙うぞ。ホバリングは休憩じゃない。
aside: Air traffic control called me a bug. I'd like a number.
今日も定時旋回。退勤方向に曲がる許可が下りない。
pressure: A lower buzz. That's your warning, not my surrender.

battle: Grab a noodle. It might not be the one I'm using!
Keep the beat. My bowl can take the hit.
どんぶりでガツンと守る！ コシだけのやつだと思うなよ！
aside: ダンス教室で『体の芯を意識して』って言われた。ゆで時間の話かな。
My dance teacher said, 'Find your core.' More cooking time?
pressure: Getting softer. Still got a little bounce in me!

battle: Every seat has a wonderful view of my next attack!
Up you go. Whether you booked the ride or not!
ギラリと見て反撃！ 回転の向きだけで、油断しないで！
aside: No waiting time! For you. I'm still going round.
頂点で告白の練習をしたら、下まで聞こえていました。
pressure: Dizzy already? We've barely started the evening service!

battle: Don't assume the waves have taken your side.
A flower can close up as neatly as it opens.
風を捕まえて反撃！ 舟の先が、君の守りへ向かうわ。
aside: I picked petals to choose a route. Now I'm sinking.
花占いで進路を決めたら、舟が少しずつ小さくなったの。
pressure: It's rough water. I'm still the one steering.

battle: You're small. That's no reason for me to hold back.
Simple plan. Very large fists.
岩を合わせて反撃する。右の拳だけ、地層が少し古いんだ。
aside: I loosened my shoulder. A fossil fell out.
腕時計のバンドを特注した。時計より、バンド代が高かった。
pressure: A few cracks. There's good rock underneath.

battle: Lid closed! You can still hear the story, right?
This cheese has matured. So has my argument.
壺の腹で受けるぞ。熟成の重み、伊達じゃないぜ！
aside: A thirty-second explanation? Give me three years to mature it.
この話、ちょっと匂う？ いいところまで発酵してきたんだよ！
pressure: Less cheese. More flavor. Plenty more to say.

battle: Petting privileges have to be earned. Carefully.
You wanted a house cat? Wrong mountain.
爪で返すわ。おとなしい猫を期待したなら、山を間違えたわね。
aside: I don't need a higher rank. Just a higher shelf.
山猫会議で一言も発言しなかった。みんな窓の鳥を見ていたニャ。
pressure: Messy fur. Perfectly organized claws.

battle: Don't chase the shadow. I'm already turning.
Thin wings. Less air to fight through.
低く飛ぶ。君が構える高さは、もう知った。
aside: My body double and I both requested cloudy days off.
影武者を雇ったら、曇りの日に二人とも休みたがった。
pressure: Wings still open. No reason to land.

battle: Fall in! Even your attacks need to keep time.
One officer. An entire parade's worth of enthusiasm.
大きく一歩、反撃だ！ 音が遅れても、足は遅れん！
aside: 静かに集合せよと号令したら、自分の太鼓で聞こえなかった。
I ordered silence. Nobody heard me over my own drum.
pressure: Out of breath. Not out of rhythm!

battle: Sweetness is no excuse for breaking an oath.
My spoon has duties beyond dessert.
煮詰めた鎧を信じる。苦みも少し、私の強さでしょう。
aside: They said be flexible. Perhaps turn up the heating.
融通が利かないと言われました。室温を上げれば、少しは。
pressure: Every last piece of me will honor that promise.

battle: Nice try. That ripple was part of my disguise.
Don't worry about my tail. Actually, do worry. It's lovely.
ぴちっと岩へつかまる！ 流されそうな顔で、油断を誘うんだ！
aside: Lose my tail? I'd need to consult the pattern designer.
雨の日は保護色が大忙し。晴れると、ちょっと目立っちゃう。
pressure: The pattern's a mess. The lizard's doing fine.

battle: Armor is nothing without a proper filling!
No snack breaks in the line of fire!
両腕の砲口を向ける！ 射線上のおやつ休憩は、認めん！
aside: Our supply officers keep asking about expiration dates.
兵站会議で『賞味期限』を出すのは、吾輩の部隊だけだ。
pressure: Pressure dropping. Time to settle this before the pastry bursts.

battle: The wind gets through. Your attack doesn't.
Don't let the holes fool you about these claws.
かあっと高く構える！ 空の守りは、軽い方がよいのじゃ。
aside: The jeweler checked my weight before asking how I felt.
金細工師に点検を頼んだら、まず重さを量られたぞ。
pressure: Bent wire. The sky's still within reach.

battle: Belly and swim ring. That's two lines of defense.
Let's stay where I can touch the bottom, please.
両足で踏ん張る！ 深い所へ押すのは、ちょっと待って！
aside: I'm a hippo. That doesn't make me your swimming coach.
カバだから泳げると思った？ 種族への期待、いったん置こう。
pressure: The ring's fine. My courage has a slow leak.

battle: Hesitation only slows the blade.
A narrow opening is still a way forward.
青い尾で水を蹴る。速さもまた、守りの一つ。
aside: 鼻先で指差したら、地図に穴を開けてしまった。
I pointed out the route. Now the map has a hole.
pressure: A strong current won't change where I'm headed.

battle: Hard-headed? I choose to take that as a compliment.
Let's nail this down before we start arguing.
柄を踏ん張って構える！ 曲げる気はない、木だから曲がるけど！
aside: They asked for flexible thinking. My rubber brother got hired.
謝ると頭を下げるだろ。机が一つ、壊れちまうんだよ。
pressure: My handle may bend. My answer's still no!

battle: An owl's look. A fox's next move.
Listen for wings if you like. I'm still a fox.
耳を澄まして反撃。羽音を探しても、わたしは狐なのよ。
aside: They scheduled my night-creature interview for nine in the morning.
夜行性の履歴書に、朝の面接時間を書かれてしまった。
pressure: The moon may shrink. The night isn't finished.

battle: Stack the tiles. Leave the inspection until after the fight!
I can be a wall and still have a sense of humor.
陶の壁を立てる！ ひびのチェックは、勝負の後で頼むよ！
aside: Rain shelter? I'd love to charge a maintenance fee.
焼き直しで強くなる？ おいら、窯の予約が怖いんだ。
pressure: One tile missing. The rest of me is still on duty.

battle: Good sauce takes time. So does getting past me.
Mind the mustache. It's longer than your reach.
壺を傾けて構える。ぽたっと一滴も、無駄にはせぬぞ。
aside: Shorten my speeches if you must. Don't dilute the miso.
ぽたぽた落ちるから、足跡より先に晩ごはんの匂いがつく。
pressure: One drop left. Enough to make my final point.

battle: I follow the wind. I don't take orders from it.
Even a headwind has its uses.
長い足で踏み込むぞ。地平線より近い所にも、王の道はある。
The long journey belongs to those who prepare.
帆の影から切り返す。大きな姿ほど、影も味方になるのだ。
aside: Three hundred days on sand. One very repetitive diary.
港のない国ゆえ、出航式のテープがいつも砂に埋まるのじゃ。
No sea in sight. Still very much the captain.
pressure: No kneeling in the sand. The route goes on.
風が止まっても、余は歩ける。最後に頼る帆は、この意志じゃ。

battle: Seven colors. Try not to lose yourself in the details.
Even beauty needs a few layers of protection.
指先から光を返します。こちらを見たまま、お避けくださいな。
I can take my own steps, even in this dress.
光を絞って一筋に。広がるばかりが、虹の力ではありません。
aside: I wanted transparent government. The dressmakers had questions.
透明な政治を目指したら、衣装係が一番困っておりました。
A rainbow doesn't make room for a second queen.
pressure: Fading colors. A queen who hasn't gone anywhere.
雨上がりを待つだけではありません。最後の虹は、自ら架けますわ。

battle: Closed wings. Open options.
A quiet order is still an order.
金の爪で地をとらえる。退かぬ場所を、先に決めておいた。
Watch my wings, not just the flag.
かあ、と短く告げよう。これが次の突入の合図だ。
aside: The report was so heavily censored, it looked like night.
作戦書の黒塗りが多すぎて、配る前から夜になっていた。
Hold the line. The sky can wait.
pressure: Fewer feathers. No change in command.
最後の羽にも、進む方向はある。地に伏すまで、私が将だ。

battle: We'll start with a smile. The tears can wait.
Three faces. One body. Please reach a decision!
上の顔が攻撃を命じた！ 下の顔は、まだ防御中じゃが！
The angry face attacked. The happy one claimed the credit.
仮面を入れ替えて構える。どの顔にも、王の意地があるのじゃ。
aside: A hundred accounts? We'd prefer one bill.
顔認証で百人分のアカウントを勧められた。支払いは一人分がよい。
A fresh face. The same old royal headache.
pressure: One smile down. Plenty of stubborn faces left.
最後の面を外しても、まだ余らは余ら。この勝負、顔をそむけぬぞ！

battle: I'm working against the clock. I am the clock.
Two seconds ahead. Please don't ruin my schedule.
時計のふたで受けます。傷がついても、時間は止めません！
aside: 時刻どおりに飛ぶ仕事で、毎日自分自身に遅刻を注意されています。
Time flies. I seem to need more practice.
pressure: It's not closing time until my hands say so.

battle: I'll leave you some cream. Consider it a souvenir!
It's a sweet act. That doesn't make me a pushover.
チェリーを揺らして反撃！ 飾りまで本気になると、こうなるの！
aside: I asked for a colorful life. They brought food coloring.
人生に彩りをって言われて、着色料の相談をしちゃった。
pressure: The cream's slipping. The punchline is still mine!

battle: Small horns. Plenty of growing room.
These flowers aren't just here to make me blush.
ひづめでこつんと返す！ 足音は大人っぽくできたかな！
aside: Don't praise my cheeks. They might start blooming.
ほっぺのつぼみ、ほめられると開きそうで困っちゃう。
pressure: I haven't even bloomed yet. Don't call this over!

battle: I appreciate a sharp mind. But pencils taste better.
I've still got room for one more pencil.
鉄の腹で受けるぞ。胃袋には、まだ鉛筆一本ぶんの余裕がある！
aside: Red pencils for breakfast. Now every report looks alarming.
芯のあるやつが好きだ。恋愛じゃなく、晩ごはんの話な。
pressure: Being full and giving up are two different things!

battle: Delicate lace. A rather determined little bird.
You don't need a loud voice to make a point.
小さなくちばしで返すわね。大きな声だけが、強さではないもの。
aside: Curry in white lace. That's my idea of bravery.
羽の洗濯表示を探したけれど、背中だから読めなかったの。
pressure: A loose thread won't keep me from flying.

battle: Left, right... Oh, you came straight down the middle.
Stay back. I can't focus on something that close!
レンズを引いて守る！ 近づかれると、逆に君がぼやける！
aside: My eyes have different hobbies. Travel planning is a nightmare.
左右の目が別々の趣味を持ち始めた。旅行先が決まらない。
pressure: Seeing double doesn't mean I agreed to two opponents!

battle: Two slippers. Twice the chance of getting in your way!
Already awake? We can still give you a proper surprise!
そろって着地で受ける！ サイズ違いの一撃は、お断りだぜ！
aside: We get stepped on for a living. Then complain about it.
踏まれる仕事なのに、踏まれると跳ねる。職業選択を間違えたか。
pressure: Springs compressed. Perfect timing for one last leap!

battle: Looking up is only the beginning. Try keeping up.
A little morning mist. Courtesy of these opal spots.
細いひづめで踏み込むの。遠くからでも、一歩は一歩よ。
aside: People ask for directions. I can't even see my feet.
朝霧が出ると迷子の相談が増えるの。わたしも足元は見えないけど。
pressure: The mist is lifting. I'm not backing away.

battle: I'm calculating the odds. Could you attack a little later?
Press any button. Except clear. Especially not clear!
ボタンの壁で受ける！ そこ、クリアだけは押さないで！
aside: 何でも数字で考えるのに、暗証番号を毎回忘れるんだ。
My sums are right. My confidence needs work.
pressure: Forget the odds. I'm taking my chances.

battle: Soft ears. Surprisingly good at bouncing back.
I can smell your next move. Not just the snacks.
くんくん、次の動きのにおい！ おやつの方じゃないよ！
aside: You may pet the ears. Eating them isn't an option.
耳を食べようとしないでね。なでるなら、何回でもいいよ。
pressure: Tail up. I'm staying in this until the end!

battle: Count the beads if you like. I'll be moving.
Defense needs a good color scheme too.
きらりと振り返って反撃！ 後ろ姿を、見せるだけじゃないわ。
aside: I'd take the jewelry off, if I knew where I ended.
ビーズの数を聞かれるたび、羽づくろいが数え直しになるの。
pressure: One bead down. Plenty of sparkle left.

battle: Keep the lid on. I'm saving this warmth for later.
Put that teacup away. This isn't the tea break.
取っ手で踏ん張る。ふぁあ、寝返りよりは難しいのう。
aside: We slept on the issue. Nobody cooled down.
一晩寝かせた議題を開けたら、まだ誰も冷静になっておらんかった。
pressure: My last cup will have a little extra determination.

battle: I'm not annoyed. My face just looks like that.
Hands off the pea. That's practically my crown!
グリーンピースを狙うなよ！ おれの王冠みたいなものなんだ！
aside: I tried smiling. The wrapper didn't appreciate the effort.
蒸し暑い職場？ おれにとっては、だいたい適温だ。
pressure: More wrinkles. Still plenty of bounce.

battle: No loose ends. I intend to keep it that way.
Fine threads get stronger when they're woven together.
耳を伏せて踏み込むよ。静かな僕にも、急ぐ瞬間はあるんだ。
aside: 星座を織り込んだら、占い師に著作権の相談をされた。
I wove in a constellation. The fortune-teller asked about copyright.
pressure: I'll be the one to tie the final knot.

battle: I'll look for the brakes after I've won.
Try keeping up. I'll even accept compliments on the way.
車輪を鳴らして突っ込む！ 追いついたら、褒めてやるよ！
aside: 止まらない成長を目指した。坂道で達成して、少し後悔してる。
I wanted unstoppable progress. The hill took that literally.
pressure: A shaky wheel won't make me quit before the finish.

battle: The handles are for carrying me. Please keep that in mind.
Why stand up when I can swat you from here?
編み目のすき間から見てるわ。かくれたつもりは、君の方？
aside: Organized? I just climbed into the basket.
収納上手ってほめられた。何も片づけず、自分が入っただけよ。
pressure: This basket is taken. Until further notice.

battle: Full cheeks. That's what I call a sound investment.
My hands are full. My tail can handle the rest.
ちちっ、横へ飛ぶ！ 実が転がる方まで、計算したからね！
aside: My nut subscription exceeded my cheek storage limit.
ナッツのサブスクを始めたら、頬袋の空き容量が足りなかった。
