pressure: Energy and snacks have separate budgets.

battle: Don't judge strength by the size of the petals.
Even a powerful blow leaves a little opening.
鏡の花に光を集める。私を狙うなら、まぶしさも受け取って。
aside: A stronger detergent scent? I have enough competition already.
香りの強い洗剤を勧められたわ。私には、少し競争が激しいの。
pressure: Flowers may fall. Patience can still take root.

battle: A tangled defense. Good luck finding the loose end.
Check the socket first. Then look like you knew all along.
もぞっとよけるぞ。足を出すたびに、一本ついてくる！
aside: I found the spare cable. Turns out it was me.
抜いていい線を探して三時間。全部、おれだった。
pressure: Don't pull the plug on me just yet!

battle: Dinner will wait. Your manners should not.
A little taste before you ask for seconds.
器を回して受け流します。こぼすのは、礼儀に反しますもの。
Do take this while it's warm.
お皿の底まで力を込めます。見た目以上に、よい器ですの。
aside: The soup was late. I got lost in the hallway.
本日の献立は秘密です。材料本人にも、まだ伝えておりません。
Soup's on. Please bring your best defense.
pressure: Less soup. A deeper flavor. We're not finished yet.
最後の一さじまで、丁寧にお相手しますわ。晩餐係の誇りですもの。

battle: Beyond this point, you're my responsibility.
Past the claws? The tail is waiting above.
青銅の腹で受ける。磨かれた傷も、任務の記録だ。
aside: 玄関警備を頼まれた。私が立つと、住人まで裏口を使う。
No small print. Just a very firm security policy.
pressure: The gate stays shut. Those are still my orders.

battle: A small dent? Your reflection will look slimmer.
This isn't stealing. It's an ambitious serving technique.
ナプキンをひるがえしてかわす。食卓より、動きは軽いんだ。
aside: Just one taste. Eighty times. Details matter.
テーブルマナー講座は皆勤さ。怪しまれないための勉強だからね。
pressure: I refuse to get caught before dessert.

battle: One card for defense. Its value can remain a mystery.
The nose measures distance. It doesn't measure honesty.
カードの裾を返して一撃。読めないのは、顔だけではない。
aside: I taught poker faces. The feedback was hard to read.
この顔でサプライズされた。喜んでいる証拠写真が、一枚もない。
pressure: Fewer cards. No reason to show my hand.

battle: You'll need more than a glance to see through this armor.
The battlefield extends beyond the front of my wings.
金の爪を立てて返す。磨かれた姿にも、獣の力は残る。
aside: I am a dragon. Not your dressing-room mirror.
乾くまで触るなと言われた。戦の予定が、三日延びた。
pressure: The lacquer may peel. The dragon remains.

battle: I'll send that attack back with the next wave.
The more you look for my front, the farther away I am.
細い尾をしならせ反撃。結び目のないリボンは、自由でしょう？
aside: 贈り物のラッピングを頼まれた。箱ごと海に運んでしまったわ。
Gift wrapping? I may have taken the box out to sea.
pressure: A thin wave can still reach the shore.

battle: A little bite in the middle. That's proper pasta armor.
You're holding the fork. Don't assume you're in charge.
ラザニアの盾を立てる！ 層の厚さには、理由があるんだ！
aside: Nine minutes of service. At ten, the whole squad goes soft.
上官が『もっとこしらえろ』と命じた。コシならもう十分だろ！
pressure: Softening pasta. An absolutely firm decision to keep fighting.

battle: Great timing. Shame about that excuse for an attack!
I'll turn the volume down. Not the determination.
一歩引いて構える！ ツッコミにも、間合いってもんがある！
aside: I opened a quiet dojo. The neighbors requested soundproofing.
突っ込む前に考えろと言われた。考えすぎて、話題が変わった。
pressure: Save the last comeback for me!

battle: One gear can change the whole flight.
Thin fabric. A frame that knows its job.
上からすいっと反撃！ 風に乗せた分だけ、強くなるよ！
aside: My flight plan said, 'Landing to be decided.'
向かい風の面談で、追い風の実績だけをほめられた。
pressure: One last gust. I'll find a way to use it.

battle: Small tengu. A whole mountain's worth of wind.
Don't measure the nose. Watch the feet!
下駄を鳴らしてかわす！ あとから音を追っても、遅いんだ！
aside: They praised my growing nose. It was a medical checkup.
秋限定の人気者と思うなよ。夏も団扇で、ちゃんと働いてる！
pressure: I'm not heading down the mountain without a win.

battle: Spare cucumber slices. Please don't ask where they're from.
A clean cut. With a very satisfying crunch.
まっすぐ伸びて突き返す！ 少し曲がってても、気持ちはね！
aside: 剣士の募集に『瑞々しい人材』って。ぼく以外に誰がいるのさ。
Cool as a cucumber. A little sharper around the edges.
pressure: Less water. Still got that crunch.

battle: A smooth curve doesn't mean a weak tail.
Admire the fins later. The tail is moving now.
瑠璃の尾を返す。見送るつもりなら、もう一歩離れた方がいい。
aside: They wanted to display my tail. I insisted on coming too.
保護色の講習で、一人だけ『装飾色』の札を渡された。
pressure: Deep blue. Just as much resolve underneath.

battle: These patches have been through more fights than you think.
If you start pulling threads, be ready for a long story.
糸の腕をしならせて返す。ほどくつもりなら、全部付き合え。
aside: Put my life back together? I've usually got a needle.
人生をつなぎ直せって？ 針と糸なら、たいてい持ってる。
pressure: A split seam won't split my resolve.

battle: Dark cave. Your position is perfectly clear.
You look up. I call that direction home.
天井の方から反撃！ 上下を決めつけるのは、地上の癖だよ！
aside: Great applause in this cave. Mostly my own echo.
昼夜逆転を直せって言われた。コウモリの相談窓口、どこかな。
pressure: My last call will reach the back of the cave.

battle: You made a dent. I'll turn it into a new shape.
Longer arms? Give me a second to work on that.
足を広げて踏ん張る！ 面積の広さが、今日のおれの長所だ！
aside: 将来何になりたいか聞かれた。今朝の形すら、まだ迷ってる。
My future shape? I haven't decided on this morning's yet.
pressure: Not set yet. Neither the clay nor the outcome.

battle: Open jaws. Don't mistake that for a warm welcome!
Six feet on the ground. I like those odds.
六本の足で受ける！ 接地の数なら、君より有利だ！
aside: It's a pattern, not a charging port. Third explanation today.
充電器を勧められたが、模様だって説明を三回した。
pressure: One last spark of effort. The pattern stays bright!

battle: Follow the melody. The feet are just keeping time.
Cover a hole. You'll change the tune, not the target.
息をいっぱいためて返す！ 音程が外れても、狙いは外さない！
aside: I tried whistling. Then remembered I'm already a flute.
会議の空気を変えようとして、一人だけ変な音を出しちゃった。
pressure: I'm out of breath, but not out of notes.

battle: Little flowers need more than gentle words to stay safe.
I wasn't given this job just for being kind.
花びらにまぎれて返すの。風と私の違いを、見分けてね。
aside: We added flower watchers. Now the meeting room is full.
散歩の人に道を聞かれた。私も木を動かさないと、よく見えないの。
pressure: The fallen petals haven't changed what I'm here to protect.

battle: Sweet plan. Heavy jar. Don't underestimate either!
Lid up! An open jar is no excuse for an open defense.
粘るジャムで足止めだ！ 進軍計画は、今この場で煮詰める！
aside: 朝の訓示が長すぎて、パンが全部冷めた。これぞ軍の反省点じゃ。
The speech warmed our hearts. The toast went cold.
pressure: I can see the bottom. I'm still sticking to the plan.

battle: Loud doesn't mean damaged. I happen to be a bell.
Hear the first note? You're already a little late.
振り子を返して構える。反動もまた、騎士の力である！
aside: They gave me earplugs. A gift or a complaint?
耳栓を贈られた。気遣いか、抗議か、まだ判断していない。
pressure: The bell may fade. I still stand by my oath.

battle: These walls weren't built to melt at the first challenge.
A quiet king. A very cold reception.
足元を凍らせて構える。踏み込むにも、覚悟が要るであろう。
My reach goes well beyond the castle gate.
結晶を重ねて押し返す。薄氷にも、重なる強さがある。
aside: We voted for warmer rooms. The architect looked worried.
冬の王じゃが、布団から出る意志まで強いわけではない。
Stay cool. The castle depends on it.
pressure: Every crack lets the light in. I'm still standing.
最後の氷柱が立つ限り、余も立とう。春を呼ぶには、まだ早いぞ。

battle: Round I go. Good luck finding the front!
Watch the tail. It makes a complete round too.
輪をほどいて突っ込むぜ！ 丸く収まる気は、今はない！
Back where we started. That makes it my turn again!
金色の背で受ける！ ピカピカだからって、薄いメッキじゃないぜ！
aside: I offered a wider circle of friends. They measured my waist.
金の指輪に採用された。サイズが合う指を、まだ探してる。
A ring fit for a king. Preferably a giant one.
pressure: A crooked circle is still a circle. I'm not done.
最後の一回転だ！ おれさまの輪っかに、終わりを作れるか！

battle: Not all power needs to be on display.
By the time you spot the rainbow, I'll have moved.
長い袖を返して構えます。こちらの間合いへ、お入りください。
My cloak covers the back as well. No exceptions.
闇の縁から光を返す。白昼の戦いとは、勝手が違いましょう？
aside: The dress code said dark. We couldn't find the guests.
月明かりの経費を尋ねた者がおります。請求先は、今も見つかりません。
Midnight has its own colors. Do try to keep up.
pressure: Less light. All the more reason to make it count.
夜は終わっても、わたくしの意志は消えません。最後までお相手を。

battle: Today's main course is a properly challenging opponent!
Fork or spoon? Why should a king have to choose?
丸い腹で受け止める！ 王の器量は、食器の量だけではない！
We'll discuss table manners after the battle.
マントをひるがえして迫る！ 王の席からも、立つ時は立つ！
aside: A tight food budget? Leave my tasting sessions off the agenda.
『腹を割って話そう』と言われた。中身が昼ごはんなので、丁重に断った。
Dinner is served. Please don't bring a weak defense.
pressure: Not full. Just saving room for the victory feast.
最後の一皿まで、王が付き合おう。お残しは、勝機にしても許さぬぞ！
